jobs.title: Software Development Engineer II, AWS DynamoDB
jobs.jd:
Amazon DynamoDB powers many of the world's fastest-growing businesses, including Lyft, Airbnb, and Redfin. It also powers enterprises such as Samsung, Toyota, and Capital One. Within Amazon, it runs high-traffic properties including Alexa, Amazon.com, and every Amazon fulfillment center. DynamoDB is one of the largest distributed database systems in the world. We believe it is always Day 1, and we keep improving the service and adding new capabilities.

DynamoDB is a serverless, fully managed database. It delivers consistent single-digit millisecond performance at any scale, with no servers to provision, no maintenance windows, and no downtime. Customers can create a table and scale it automatically to their most demanding workloads without having to plan capacity. During Prime Day 2026, DynamoDB handled more than 59 trillion requests over four days. It peaked at 192 million requests per second while keeping single-digit millisecond response times. The Capacity & Customer Entitlement (CCE) team builds the systems behind this. We decide how much throughput and storage each customer gets and enforce quotas and limits fairly. We also keep DynamoDB's global fleet ahead of demand. When our systems do their job, customers grow without thinking about capacity, and DynamoDB runs efficiently at any scale.

Managing capacity for one of the largest databases in the world is a hard distributed systems problem. Our systems forecast demand across every AWS Region, plan and place capacity across the fleet, and manage the limits and entitlements that decide how far each customer can scale. We prepare DynamoDB for major events such as Prime Day and new Region launches, so capacity is in place well before customers need it. We are building fully automated capacity management from the ground up. It is a greenfield opportunity to design systems that detect, predict, and act on their own. Engineers on this team solve problems where accuracy, scale, and cost all matter at the same time, and their work shapes how customers experience DynamoDB.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, and operate the services that manage DynamoDB throughput, storage, quotas, and customer entitlements at global scale.
- Build automated capacity management: demand forecasting, proactive scaling, and self-healing workflows that replace manual operations.
- Build APIs and data platforms, that give DynamoDB teams and tools accurate, real-time views of capacity and usage.
- Reduce throttling, speed up limit increases, and make large-scale fleet events safe and predictable.
- Own features end to end, from design through deployment and operation, and deliver ambiguous projects with minimal guidance.
- Take part in on-call, debug issues across services, and fix root causes so problems don't come back.

Your work can span shared platform capabilities and customer-facing payment products, including global bill payments.

You’ll stay hands-on in production code and proofs of concept while setting the technical direction other engineers and teams build on. It’s an opportunity to shape both the technology and the engineering practices of a growing team, with a direct connection to the problems small businesses face every day

 - A shared payments platform: Build orchestration, risk and fraud, and multi-provider capabilities that work across products and markets, helping teams launch new payment products faster without rebuilding the same foundations.

 - High throughput at scale: Design reliable, secure distributed services that remain dependable under real-world production constraints.

You’ll work closely with engineering and cross-functional partners to make trade-offs explicit and turn direction into delivery. Your impact will come from both your own technical contributions and the capability you build in others.

jobs.jd:
Flow Traders is looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer to join the Data Platform team in our Amsterdam office.

 We are a leading proprietary trading firm with an entrepreneurial culture. We value sharp, creative engineers and give them the room and the responsibility to make full use of their abilities.

 Your mission is to build and run the platform at the centre of the firm: the source of truth for our proprietary research data, the foundation every department builds on, and the context layer our AI agents depend on. You will make it the place where anyone, human or agent, can find trusted data, understand it, and build on it quickly and safely. Working closely with our Quants and research engineers, you will help shape how the firm does systematic trading.

What you will do

- Shape our data architecture. Understand the business challenges of traders, researchers and support functions, translate them into technical solutions, and design the architecture of data systems at Flow Traders.

- Make the hard design calls. Decide on data modelling, storage formats and processing patterns, weighing performance, cost and maintainability.

- Own performance at scale. Take ownership of the distributed systems, storage and processing platforms that power our data-intensive applications. You will push them to perform under real market load, from tuning a slow pipeline to designing monitoring and alerting that catches problems before our traders do.

- Build and maintain platform capabilities. Design and maintain the products our users rely on every day: self-provisioned compute, scheduling, transformations and ad-hoc exploration. Treat quants, analysts and other teams as customers of a platform product.

- Run what you build. Keep the platform reliable on busy days, continuously improve resource usage and cost, investigate and resolve data issues and pipeline failures, and build operational tooling and runbooks.

- Enable governance and context for AI. Build and maintain the tools that make good governance possible across the firm, such as our data catalog, lineage, access control and configurable data quality rules, and promote their adoption.

- Co-develop with AI, responsibly. Use coding agents daily to design, write, test and review code, while owning the correctness of everything that ships.

- Raise the bar around you. Mentor engineers through code reviews, design discussions and pairing, including how to work effectively and critically with AI tools.

What you need to succeed

Required

- 8+ years of experience building and operating multiple data platforms in production across different domains, with the ability to reflect on past technical decisions and lessons learned.

- Strong understanding of fundamental concepts including storage layouts, query execution, networking and distributed systems behaviour.

- Ability to evaluate and communicate trade-offs between latency, cost, consistency, performance and maintainability.

- Strong data modelling and data warehousing experience, including analytical engines such as BigQuery or ClickHouse.

- Extensive hands-on experience with distributed storage, messaging systems (e.g. Kafka, Pub/Sub), batch and stream processing (e.g. Apache Beam, Spark), and container orchestration (e.g. Kubernetes).

- Strong programming skills in Python and/or Java, with high standards for testing and code quality.

- Solid cloud experience across storage, databases (e.g. AlloyDB) and data processing, preferably with GCP or AWS.

- Experience with open table formats such as Apache Iceberg or Delta Lake.

- Experience with infrastructure as code tools such as Terraform and Helm.

- Practical experience with data governance, including data ownership, lineage, access control, metadata management and data quality frameworks.

- Understanding of how AI systems consume data, including retrieval, semantic layers, tools and agent interfaces, and how to provide reliable data context for AI applications.

- Ability to translate complex business requirements into scalable technical solutions and platform capabilities.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams and mentor other engineers.

- Interest in financial markets is a plus; prior trading experience is not required.

 The Robotics Technology team is a core part of Grab's long-term vision to build urban embodied AI. SENIOR ENGINEER - PLATFORM

The role and its impact

As a Senior Engineer in our Infrastructure team, you’ll help Xero engineers build and test software faster and with more confidence. You’ll design and build the systems that create test environments, and you’ll make sure test data is ready when teams need it. This work sits at the heart of how we ship software, and it helps set Xero up for AI transformation.

You’ll work across complex platforms, including older legacy systems alongside modern technology. There will be trade-offs to weigh as you decide where the most value sits for engineering teams. Xero asks you to Go Bold in how you approach these problems, and to Go Fast without cutting corners.

The team and how they connect

Our Infrastructure team builds the platform foundations that Xero engineers rely on every day. Our engineers come from software, platform and infrastructure backgrounds, and we work closely with teams across Xero to understand their systems and find elegant solutions. We believe in Going Together, which means sharing knowledge openly and making sure everyone’s voice is heard.

The team is currently working on / Initially, you will focus on:

 - Building support systems and tooling for test environments, so engineers can test changes without waiting on blockers.

 - Improving test data and enabling frictionless testing across engineering teams.

 - Working with our Golang services, alongside infrastructure built with Terraform on AWS, including Kubernetes, EC2 and Lambda.

 - Contributing to a longer-running initiative to shorten feedback loops and increase engineering productivity.

Where and how you can work

This is a permanent role, based in Melbourne, Sydney or Brisbane with a remote-first working culture. We have no set office days, so you’ll work with your manager and team to find a balance that suits how you do your best work. Once you’ve settled in, you’ll join our on-call rotation as part of supporting the systems we build.

Here are some of the things we’re looking for, for this role:

 - Your background could be in software engineering that has moved into platform or DevOps, or in infrastructure work that understands how software is built.

 - Golang is our preferred language, though strong experience in Java or .NET is equally welcome.

 - Hands-on experience with Terraform, AWS and Kubernetes will help you hit the ground running.

 - A curious, problem-solving mindset and the ability to pick up unfamiliar systems quickly, including legacy ones, are key to how you’ll Go Further here.

 - Clear communication is second nature to you, whether you’re working in another team’s codebase or presenting to leadership.

Apply even if your experience isn’t a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

We are executing an ambitious growth plan to expand our robotics fleet across cities over the coming years, and we are focused on delivering highly productive, safe and efficient robot delivery services that help address current delivery labor shortages.
 Based in Singapore and China, our team offers opportunities to work on cutting-edge autonomy, deploy solutions in complex urban environments, and directly influence the future of last-mile logistics. If you're excited by tangible impact, large-scale systems and cross-functional engineering, you'll find meaningful challenges and rapid career growth here.
 Get to know the Role: 
 We are looking for a Data Infrastructure Engineer to own the data backbone of our robotics programme. Our fleet produces a large, continuous and unforgiving stream of data — sensor recordings, telemetry, autonomy events, and operational and delivery records — and almost every decision the team makes depends on that data arriving complete, on time and demonstrably correct. You will own the pipelines that move it, the validation and monitoring that prove it is trustworthy, the dashboards that engineering, operations and data science work from, and the integration of our robotics data and ML workloads onto Grab's existing data and ML platforms, so the team inherits Grab-scale tooling instead of rebuilding it. jobs.title: Principal Engineer - Payments Products & Platform
jobs.location: AU: Sydney (45 Clarence St) | AU: Melbourne: (260 Burwood Rd) | Sydney, Australia
jobs.jd:
THE ROLE

 

Xero reimagined accounting software. Now we’re reimagining how small businesses get paid and how money moves. We're making a critical, multi-year investment in two connected engineering portfolios, Payments Products & Experiences and Payments Platform, and we're hiring a Principal Engineer for each. As our three-year payments strategy reaches a turning point, you'll help shape what comes next, with domain-level influence over the next two to three years.

 

You'll shape technical strategy across multiple teams, partnering with senior stakeholders to turn complex requirements into scalable, resilient systems. Staying close to the technical detail, you'll set the example for a portfolio of 40 to 50 engineers. You'll also join a global community of Principal Engineers across Xero, driving engineering standards, architecture, and best practices.

 

You'll Go Bold by setting long-term direction, and Go Together by bringing product, engineering and senior stakeholders with you.

 


THE TEAMS

Payments Products & Experiences: this portfolio is made up of our Get Paid and Growth teams, builds the checkout, payment methods, flexible payments and AI payment agents that help small businesses get paid on time. 

 

Payments Platform: this portfolio is the engine underneath, with provider integrations, bill payments and a single, product-agnostic API that other Xero teams build on. 

 

Together they move billions of dollars across more than 150,000 transactions a day, a number set to double as we grow into the UK and US.

 


THE TEAMS ARE CURRENTLY WORKING ON

 - Tech stack: microservices across web, API and data layers, built in languages such as C#, Java, Go or C++, running on AWS with SQL and NoSQL data stores.

 - Current focus: reviewing existing payments systems to work out what to extend, migrate or rebuild, alongside Growth experiments and AI-powered payment chasing.

 - Future focus: a multi-year payments architecture covering agentic payment workflows, payments inside AI assistants and recurring payments.

 - Global scale: replatforming payment methods and designing global rails and a ledger ready for new markets.
   
    


WHERE AND HOW YOU CAN WORK

You'll be based in Sydney or Melbourne, working a hybrid model that blends time together in our modern offices with the flexibility of working from home. Boost days bring teams together to connect and collaborate in person. With colleagues across Australia and the US and payment flows that run around the clock, you'll also work across time zones.

 


SOME OF THE THINGS WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - You bring deep experience designing and running large-scale distributed systems in production, balancing reliability, performance and cost, and any payments or fintech experience is a real plus.

 - API-first thinking is second nature, and you're at home across web, API and data layers, with fluency in at least one modern backend language, SQL and NoSQL stores, and cloud-native platforms, ideally AWS.

 - Legacy-heavy systems are a puzzle you enjoy, and you make clear, practical calls on whether to extend, migrate or build while staying hands-on through pairing, spikes and code.

 - A strong interest in utilising AI tooling is essential, as you will model how to use these technologies to automate tasks and improve engineering outcomes.

 - Your background shows a deep curiosity for growth hacking and a proven ability to design and analyse A/B tests that drive product usage.

 - You'll Go Further by mentoring Staff and Senior engineers, shaping cross-team initiatives with Xero's Principal community and setting standards that lift engineering across Xero.
   
    

Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

Come work for Amazon Web Services (AWS) Outposts; a highly recognized hybrid cloud offering from AWS. AWS Outposts is an on-premises version of AWS public cloud providing customers access to robust AWS services and the latest generation of EC2 instance types.
Our team is responsible for managing the network route between the AWS region and Outposts site, EC2 instances platforms running at customer sites, and software deployments that run the core infrastructure of AWS Outposts services and EC2 Edge networking instances. 

We operate like a start-up team within a big enterprise. This allows us to take risk and experiment, allow team members to flex their technical muscles and grow in their respective careers, and an unique opportunity to be part of the product's growth story from Day1. Are you interested in building and managing systems in scale, interested in software defined networking, low-level programming, and building high performant applications with limited resources? If so, come join us as a Software Development Engineer.
This position involves on-call responsibilities typically for two weeks every 2-3 months. We don't like to get paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause to prevent pages for the same issues twice.
We believe good code reviews raise our code quality, grow our technical acumen and provide opportunities to support and share knowledge within the team. We are responsible for supporting our own code in production and we take our code reviews seriously and ship code every day.
To learn more about Outposts, you can visit: https://aws.amazon.com/outposts/
About Us:
Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have ten employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
Work/Life Balance
Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. It isn’t about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it’s about the flow you establish that brings energy to both parts of your life. We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives. This position involves on-call responsibilities, typically for one week every two months. We don’t like getting paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged, we work together to resolve the root cause so that we don’t get paged for the same issue twice.
Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded engineer and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Basic qualifications:
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications:
- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend
jobs.jd:
Get to Know the Team 
 The Payments FundsCore team consolidates Grab's diverse payment stacks into a single, cohesive payment platform — the financial backbone that powers transactions across all of Grab's teams and partners. We manage critical platform components, including the Payment Platform, Driver Payouts, and Fee Platform, and the Driver and Delivery Partner ledger that underpins Grab's payment capabilities. We build and operate distributed systems that process millions of transactions daily, where correctness, consistency, and scale are non-negotiable. Concepts like Idempotency, Two-Phase Commit, Event Sourcing, and the Saga pattern are central to the systems we design and evolve.
 
 Get to Know the Role 
 We're looking for an experienced Senior Backend Software Engineer to join our Payments FundsCore engineering team in Singapore. You'll build scalable distributed systems that form Grab's financial backbone, including the Payment Platform, Driver Payouts, Fee Platform, and Dax ledger.
 You'll take ownership of critical backend services that process millions of transactions daily, ensuring correctness, consistency, reliability, and performance. You'll solve complex payment challenges using concepts such as idempotency, two-phase commit, event sourcing, and the Saga pattern. You'll also collaborate with engineers and partners to evolve Grab's unified payment platform.
 You will report to the Engineering Manager II and work on-site at Grab's Singapore office.
 
 The Critical Tasks You Will Perform 
 
- Develop scalable backend systems that meet business and non-functional requirements, including reliability, security, and performance.

- Write clean, efficient, testable, and maintainable code to solve complex FinTech and payment-platform challenges.

- Build distributed systems that prioritise transaction correctness and consistency, applying patterns such as idempotency, event sourcing, and Saga.

- Collaborate with teams to deliver new capabilities.

- Conduct code reviews, maintain technical documentation, and promote knowledge sharing and engineering best practices.

- Diagnose complex production issues, create fixes, and implement sustainable solutions that prevent recurrence.

- Contribute to architectural decisions and the technical direction of projects and services.

- Strengthen system reliability through observability, automation, and operational improvements. We require participation in the on-call rotation.

- Support deployment and operational processes to maintain system health and performance.

- Mentor junior engineers and interns, promoting learning and improvement.

- Stay current with latest technologies and use Generative AI tools responsibly to improve engineering productivity and system capabilities.

What Essential Skills You Will Need 
 
- A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- At least five years of relevant software development experience.

- Proficiency in Go (preferred), Java, or another major programming language, along with the willingness to participate in professional development activities to stay current on industry knowledge.

- Computer science fundamentals, including algorithms and data structures, and the ability to apply them.

- Solve porblems with careful consideration of edge cases, failure scenarios, and system recovery.

- Experience writing efficient, maintainable, and thoroughly tested code using appropriate abstractions and SOLID principles.

- A understanding of clean architecture, data-intensive application design, and large-scale data processing.

- Experience building large-scale distributed systems using relational and NoSQL databases, caching technologies, and RESTful or gRPC services while maintaining data consistency.

- Practical experience with microservices, cloud platforms such as AWS, and DevOps practices.

- Experience designing systems that meet observability, availability, security, data governance, regulatory, and compliance requirements.

- Produce clear technical design documents and maintain operational documentation, including runbooks.

- Experience using Generative AI tools responsibly to improve engineering productivity and project delivery.

- We prefer knowledge of or experience in FinTech and payment systems.

Life at Grab 
 We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
 
- We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance. 

- With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.

- Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave , and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave

- We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.

- Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours.
 
 What We Stand For at Grab 
 We are committed to building an inclusive and equitable workplace that enables diverse Grabbers to grow and perform at their best. As an equal opportunity employer, we consider all candidates fairly and equally regardless of nationality, ethnicity, religion, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, family commitments, physical and mental impairments or disabilities, and other attributes that make them unique.

jobs.jd:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 The Platform Infrastructure, Control Team 

 The Auth0 platform secures more than 100 million logins each day for customers all around the world - and we're growing fast! The Platform Control team enables Auth0 engineers to move faster by giving them tools to easily deploy and manage their services on AWS and Azure. This is a role with a huge impact. You will get to work with engineers throughout the organization and what you build will be a foundational piece of the infrastructure that allows Auth0 to scale for years to come.

 Software Engineer II, Platform Infrastructure - Control 

 We are looking for an Engineer who is passionate about building robust orchestration systems, idempotent APIs, and high-quality developer tooling. Because we build the "brain" of the platform - handling everything from environment provisioning to emergency rollbacks, the ideal candidate is someone who is obsessed with system state consistency and creating a seamless, self-service experience for other engineers.

 What you’ll be doing 

- Help build, maintain, and scale the Control Server, API, and CLI tools that manage the lifecycle of our environments, from provisioning to decommissioning.

- Contribute to backend logic powering automated rollbacks, hotfixes, and release patching to keep deployments safe and predictable.

- Enhance automated provisioners that enable product teams to self-serve high-fidelity test environments without friction.

- Implement and maintain event publishing pipelines to broadcast environment state changes reliably across platform services.

- Improve the developer experience by contributing to well-documented, intuitive CLI and API interfaces with actionable error messaging.

- Collaborate with Product, Security, and Quality Engineering teams to execute complex lifecycle workflows while adhering to platform standards.

- Participate in the team’s goalie rotation to support build and production operations when issues arise.

 What you’ll bring to the role 

- Have 3+ years of software development experience, with a focus on building APIs, CLI tools, or backend services.

When payouts land smoothly, a business’s cash flow stays healthy, so your work has a real and visible effect on the customers we serve. You’ll get deep exposure to payments at scale and room to shape architecture, delivery and team capability.

You’ll work closely with Product and Design, and collaborate with engineering, Security, Risk and Operations partners across Xero across timezones.

 - Our stack: .NET (C#), AWS, Postgres and DynamoDB, with an API-first, mostly backend focus and tier 1 services that need high availability and test coverage above 90%.

 - Hard problems, high scale: Global rails, orchestration, compliance, fraud design and more.

 - Early stage, real ownership: Define foundational systems that future revenue and product lines will depend on.

 - Massive impact: Shape a global payments platform critical to Xero’s revenue and customer growth.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Define and build core platform services: Lead the design and development of reliable, scalable, secure services, and shape the technical foundation for Xero’s money movement capabilities.

 - Stay hands-on: Contribute directly to production code, proofs of concept and technical deep dives.

 - Drive technical excellence: Set a high bar for reliability, security and scale through design reviews and best practices.

 - Ensure operational excellence: Lead on-call practices, build robust observability and champion high-performance, reliable systems.

 - Collaborate cross-functionally: Translate complex business needs into resilient engineering solutions.

 - Mentor and grow engineers: Act as a role model and coach, fostering a culture of inclusion, collaboration and excellence.

 - Drive innovation with AI: Champion AI tools and practices across the team, from accelerating development workflows to strengthening the platform.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Experience: Hands-on experience in a senior technical role such as Staff Engineer or Tech Lead, delivering highly available, distributed backend systems at scale, ideally in payments, fintech or another regulated space.

 - Architecture and API design: Depth in secure, high-throughput services, including knowing when a synchronous API fits and when an asynchronous, event-based design serves customers better.

 - Technical foundations: Proficiency in at least one modern backend language (C# is a bonus, but Java, Go or C++ work too), cloud-native experience (ideally AWS), and both SQL and NoSQL databases.

jobs.jd:
Role Description 

 As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will own and improve Dropbox’s Windows endpoint platform. You will bring deep Windows and Intune expertise, make patching and application delivery more reliable, and build automation that reduces recurring work for the team.

 This is a hands-on role combining Windows technical ownership with the development of a more code-managed endpoint platform. You will help evaluate and adopt FleetDM, osquery, infrastructure-as-code, and GitOps practices where they improve reliability, visibility, and maintainability. You will strengthen the current environment while building and validating the path forward—not assume that replacing a tool is the answer.

 You will work with CorpInfra, IAM, Security, and support teams to make practical technical decisions, lead multi-phase improvements, and clarify ownership. You will also mentor teammates through pairing, code review, and shared operational practices. This is an individual-contributor role, not a people-management position.

 Responsibilities 

- Own endpoint reliability and lifecycle management. Improve provisioning, application delivery, updates, security configuration, and troubleshooting across the endpoint environment. 

- Make patching predictable and safe. Strengthen update workflows through testing, controlled rollouts, and remediation. 

- Make fleet health trustworthy and actionable. Improve reporting on device health, patching, and configuration, with clear ownership for resolving issues. 

- Build maintainable automation. Turn recurring work into reliable, tested workflows that other engineers can operate. 

- Advance code-managed endpoint operations. Adopt tools and practices that improve configuration management, validation, and deployment. 

- Lead cross-functional platform improvements. Define practical roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and balance security, reliability, employee experience, and team capacity. 

- Strengthen the team’s capability. Mentor teammates, review code and designs, and document reusable practices that improve coverage across the endpoint team. 

 Requirements 

- Significant experience engineering and operating Windows endpoint environments, with personal ownership beyond ticket handling or routine console administration. 

- Deep hands-on Intune experience across device lifecycle, configuration and compliance policies, application management, update workflows, and relevant Entra ID dependencies. 

- Strong Windows troubleshooting skills across operating-system behavior, services, logs, networking, certificates, identity, and security controls. Able to distinguish reported management status from actual endpoint health. 

- Recent ownership of Windows and third-party application patching, including staged deployment, user-impact validation, failed-device handling, exceptions, and recovery. 

- Strong practical PowerShell skills and familiarity with at least one additional programming language, such as Python, Go, or C#. Experience building and maintaining production automation or systems integrations. 

- Demonstrated use of version control, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for operational changes. Able to explain safe retries, failure handling, secrets management, and configuration drift. 

- Ability to independently define and deliver multi-phase work, prioritize under ambiguity, partner across teams, and mentor other engineers. 

- Clear written and verbal communication, including concise technical decisions, incident updates, runbooks, and effective asynchronous collaboration. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Production experience with FleetDM on Windows , including agent operations, policies, queries, targeting, API integrations, or configuration managed through GitOps. 

- Practical osquery and SQL experience for endpoint inventory, health, or security use cases, including query validation, performance considerations, and handling stale or missing results. 

- Experience with infrastructure-as-code or declarative configuration, continuous integration and delivery, and migration or coexistence between endpoint-management platforms. 

- Experience with Automox, Patch My PC, or comparable tools , and with endpoint privilege management, application control, encryption, or other security controls. 

- Experience supporting developer-heavy, distributed environments and contributing reusable automation across Windows, macOS, or Linux. 

 Durable Skills 

 AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve: 

- Awareness: U nderstand yourself and others . 

- Judgment: E valuat e information and mak e decisions in complex situations . 

- Adaptability: L earn, adjust, and stay effective through change . 

- Connection: C ommunicat e , collaborat e , and build trust . 

 To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

 This role is not available in Zone 1 

 US Zone 2
 $159,100 — $215,300 USD 

 US Zone 3
 $141,400 — $191,400 USD

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, AWS Security Epoxy
jobs.jd:
Amazon Security operates at a scale few engineers ever get to work at. Epoxy is the team that builds the automation making that coverage possible. We are looking for a Software Development Engineer to support the building and operating of the platforms that onboard threat detection, remediate security risk, and accelerate security response across every AWS account.

AWS Security, Epoxy builds a collection of automation platforms for AWS Security. We enable threat detection across a large fleet of AWS accounts (onboarding coverage, auditing it continuously, and making findings available to partner teams), we help partner teams remediate detected risks and respond to incidents automatically at scale, and we run the foundational services (communications, workflow orchestration, data enrichment, and secure access) that the rest of AWS Security][ operations relies on. Our systems operate at very high scale and carry a high operational bar: you build it, you run it.

You are a Software Development Engineer who enjoys taking a difficult, loosely specified problem and turning it into a well designed, thoroughly tested, and cleanly operated system. You care about the quality of what you ship and about leaving the systems you touch better than you found them. Experience in security is a plus, but it is not a requirement: what matters most is that you build robust, maintainable, high quality software using modern practices and technologies such as AWS services, Python, and TypeScript, and that you take ownership of the operational health of what you deliver.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and deliver features and components that solve difficult problems across AWS Security Epoxy's services, working independently from a well understood business goal even when the implementation is not fully specified.

- Own the operational excellence of the systems you work on: instrument them, alarm on the right signals, and drive down operational load through automation rather than manual toil.

- Write high quality, well tested code that meets a high engineering bar, and clear documentation and runbooks that let others maintain and extend your work.

- Participate in the team on-call rotation, supporting our services and responding to high-severity requests from AWS Security operations and Partner Teams. You resolve issues, then eliminate their contributing causes with permanent fixes.

- Improve the resiliency, scalability, and safety of systems that operate at very high scale, making sound trade-offs between short-term needs and long-term maintainability.

- Raise the bar through code reviews, design reviews, operational readiness reviews, and post-incident analyses, giving useful and actionable feedback including to more senior engineers.

- Mentor newer teammates and interns, and begin to influence partner teams by helping them adopt sound engineering and operational practices.

A day in the life
You pick up a feature request on one of Epoxy's services, break it into deliverable pieces, and ship it incrementally with tests and monitoring in place.

You review a teammate's design, ask the questions that surface a hidden resiliency risk, and help simplify the approach before code is written.

On an on-call week, you triage a high-severity issue, mitigate customer impact quickly, then open the follow-up work to make sure that class of failure cannot recur.

You spot a piece of manual operational work your team repeats every week and replace it with automation, giving the whole team time back.

You sync with a partner detection or response team to understand how they use an Epoxy capability, and feed what you learn back into the roadmap.

We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Data Center Builder Tools
jobs.jd:
The Data Center Builder Tools team is looking for a seasoned, self-directed Senior Software Development Engineer (SDE III) to lead the design and evolution of the real-time middleware and controls platform that powers industrial control systems across AWS Data Centers worldwide. Contribute to Amazon's vision of developing the safest, most secure, reliable, and efficient data centers on Earth.

As a Senior Software Development Engineer on this team, you will set the technical direction for the software that sits between industrial hardware and the cloud, a unified, real-time data plane that lets control applications, device drivers, and cloud services exchange data reliably on industrial computing hardware. This is deep systems work at the boundary of software and hardware: you will own the architecture of the controls, the communication layer, and the protocol and cloud integrations that the entire platform is built on, and you will be the engineer others turn to for the hardest problems in real-time, distributed, and embedded systems.

In this role you will

Own the architecture: of the real-time middleware and controls, the data-exchange layer, canonical type system, and communication patterns (publish/subscribe and request/reply) that connect distributed control applications across languages and hardware and drive it through multiple iterations as requirements scale.

Set technical strategy: for how the platform integrates with industrial automation platforms and hardware protocols (e.g. IEC 61131-3, EtherCAT, PROFINET, Modbus, OPC-UA, IO-Link) and how new device drivers are built, so the platform scales to many protocols without bespoke effort.

Define the edge-to-cloud contract: how telemetry, metrics, and commands flow between devices and AWS services, with the right delivery guarantees, quality-of-service, and failure semantics for each class of data.

Solve the defining hard problems: of a system where correctness means both the right result and the right timing, bounded latency, determinism, resource constraints on embedded hardware, and graceful degradation when connectivity is lost.

 The senior technical architect, infrastructure and cloud sets direction for how our corporate and cloud infrastructure evolves to support secure, reliable, scalable, and cost-effective business services. As part of the technical architecture team, this role connects infrastructure and cloud decisions to enterprise architecture and the broader technology roadmap. We are seeking an exceptional Software Development Engineer III to build the foundational systems and consumer-facing features that enable trustworthy, accessible AI experiences at scale. You will partner closely with our Product Manager-Technical to design and implement AI-driven operational tooling, provable data-governance frameworks, and accessibility features that set the standard for consumer AI products.

This is a high-impact role where you'll tackle complex technical challenges at the intersection of AI innovation and customer trust—reducing operational burden through automation, making data classified, controlled and provably compliant, and ensuring the experiences we ship work for every customer.

Key job responsibilities
What You'll Build

Data Governance — Classified, Controlled & Provably Compliant:

- Build data-classification and tagging systems that identify and label sensitive data at scale without linear headcount growth

- Design redaction, filtering, and crypto-shredding / delete-by-key pipelines that enforce data-handling restrictions provably and at runtime

- Create data-minimization and access-control frameworks that let the business demonstrate compliance on demand

- Operate and harden live production governance systems, instrumenting them so compliance posture is measurable and auditable

AI Enablement Systems:

- Build AI-powered metrics and conversational agents that give the org self-serve program health, root-cause analysis, and LLM-generated summaries across trust, privacy, and OE metrics

- Design config-driven agent frameworks (tool-calling, action groups, investigation protocols) so new capabilities and metrics onboard without code changes

- Develop debugging and log-traceability agents that trace an interaction end-to-end across every service component, so engineers debug in minutes instead of hunting logs per system

- Architect agent authentication and token-propagation (e.g. user-identity / Midway into agent tool calls) that is secure by design

Inclusive Experience — Accessibility by Design:

- Develop accessibility features for AI experiences that work across diverse abilities, contexts, and modalities from the start rather than as an afterthought

- Build the instrumentation that measures accessibility coverage and adoption so inclusive experiences are tracked like any other first-class metric

- Create cross-device, multimodal interfaces (text, voice, visual) that preserve a consistent, inclusive experience across surfaces

- Partner with UX and research to turn inclusive-design principles into shipped, measurable product capabilities

Key Technical Challenges

- Automation vs. Accuracy: Drive operational burden down through AI automation while keeping leadership-facing metrics and root-cause output correct and trustworthy

- Governance at Scale: Classify and control sensitive data across high scale volume without linear headcount growth, and prove compliance rather than assert it

- End-to-End Observability: Trace interactions across many distributed service components with low latency, surfacing the right context for fast debugging

- Multimodal & Inclusive Systems: Architect systems that handle text, voice, and visual inputs while delivering an accessible experience across modalities and devices

What Makes You Successful

Customer Obsession for Trust: You deeply understand that trust is earned through consistent, transparent, and privacy-respecting experiences. You make technical decisions that prioritize customer trust even when it means additional complexity.

Technical Excellence: You have strong computer science fundamentals and practical experience building distributed systems. You write clean, maintainable code and establish best practices that enable your team to move fast without breaking things.

AI & Privacy Expertise: You understand both the capabilities and limitations of modern AI systems. You know how to implement privacy-preserving techniques without sacrificing user experience.

Bias for Action: You thrive in ambiguous environments where you need to make pragmatic trade-offs between innovation and safety. You ship iteratively and learn from customer feedback.

Collaboration & Communication: You partner effectively with product managers, UX designers, data scientists, and other engineers. You can explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and influence architectural decisions across teams.

Inclusive Mindset: You design systems that work for all customers, considering diverse abilities, contexts, and use cases from the start rather than as an afterthought.

- Work on generative AI technology that impacts millions of customers daily

- Shape the future of responsible AI and set industry standards for privacy and trust

- Partner with world-class product, design, and research teams

- Solve novel technical challenges at the intersection of AI innovation and customer protection

- Build systems that make AI accessible and trustworthy for everyone

You will be working with a group of talented engineers and scientists on running experiments to test scientific proposal/solutions to improve our trust-preserving experiences. Lendable is on a mission to build the world's best technology to help people get credit and save money. We're building one of the world’s leading fintech companies and are off to a strong start:



 - One of the UK’s most exciting unicorns with a team of over 800 people

 - Backed by top investors including Balderton Capital and Goldman Sachs

So far, we’ve rebuilt the Big Three consumer finance products from scratch: loans, credit cards and car finance. We get money into our customers’ hands in minutes instead of days.



We’re growing fast, and there’s a lot more to do: we’re going after the two biggest Western markets (UK and US) where trillions worth of financial products are held by big banks with dated systems and painful processes.




JOIN US IF YOU WANT TO

 1. Take ownership: you are trusted to make decisions that drive a material impact on the direction and success of Lendable from day 1

 2. Work in small teams of exceptional people: Lendies are relentlessly resourceful. We challenge the status quo to solve problems and find smarter solutions

 3. Build the best technology in-house: we use new data sources, machine learning and AI to make machines do the heavy lifting



Operations is roughly half of Lendable's people. Central Ops Engineering is a small product engineering team that builds the tooling to help keep back office operations lean and efficient, while maintaining good customer outcomes.

We're hiring a senior product engineer who can own and deliver large problems in that space. You'll build the internal web apps and automations that agents use every day, and help shape how the team uses AI coding tools.




WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

Current problems include:

 - Complaints: we've already made handling much more efficient for officers, and are continuing to push on this.

 - Fraud and Fincrime: putting the signals an investigator needs into one place.

 - Quality assurance: using AI to review far more calls than a QA team can sample, and directing coaching to the agents who need it.
   
   


HOW WE WORK

We use Claude Code, Codex, Augment and other AI tools every day. They've tripled our productivity, and we want you to help decide where we take that next. You'll hand real work to coding agents and take responsibility for what ships.

You'll work directly with ops agents and their managers, and with Product. Data Science and Analytics own the models and prompt engineering, and you'll build the tools that put their work in front of agents.

 - An experienced product engineer with a strong track record of delivering practical, full-stack solutions on modern technology

 - Comfortable with ambiguity and focused on business outcomes, looking beyond the stated requirements to address the underlying problem

 - Enthusiastic about AI-assisted development, ideally with a record of using it to improve how your team delivers
   
   


OUR TECH STACK

 - Backend: Python and FastAPI

 - Frontend: React, Next.js and Tailwind

 - Infrastructure: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, Argo and Terraform

 - Data: SQL & Snowflake

 - Patterns: Domain Driven Design, message-driven systems and event sourcing
   
   


INTERVIEW PROCESS

 1. Intro call with Talent (30 min).

 2. Coding exercise in your own time ([2-3 hours max]). It's a small internal-tool problem, and you should use AI tools as you normally would.

 3. Technical interview (60 min). You'll walk us through your exercise, then we'll change the requirements and extend it together.

 4. Culture and behavioural interview (60 min), with time for your questions.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Backend (ML Training and Serving)
jobs.location: Remote Canada | Remote Canada | Remote US
jobs.jd:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

 About the team

 Machine Learning is central to how Affirm delivers on its mission, powering decisions across underwriting, fraud, servicing, and personalization. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to join our ML Training & Serving engineering team, the team that builds and operates the critical infrastructure that enables models to be trained and served across Affirm. 

 This role sits at the intersection of distributed systems, ML infrastructure, and platform engineering. We value engineers who listen closely, invite feedback, and work effectively across organizational boundaries, while maintaining a high bar for ownership, technical judgment, and execution. Strong candidates care about building reliable shared platforms, improving developer velocity, and creating durable systems that enable teams across the company to move faster with confidence. 

 What You'll Do 

· You will be responsible for owning and delivering quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers on your team through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.
· You will support your peers and stakeholders in the product development lifecycle by collaborating with product management, design & analytics by participating in ideation, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly consider risks and trade-offs.
· You will proactively identify project, process, technology or business issues, advocate for them, and lead in solving them.
· You will support the operations and availability of your team’s artifacts by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and supporting “keep the lights on” & on-call efforts.
· You will foster a culture of quality and ownership on your team by setting or improving code review and design standards for your team, and advocating for them beyond your team through your writing and tech talks.
· You will help develop talent on your team by providing feedback and guidance, and leading by example.

 What We Look For 

· You have 4+ years of experience designing, developing and launching backend systems at scale using languages like Python or Kotlin.
· You have a track record of developing highly available distributed systems using technologies like AWS, MySQL and Kubernetes.
· You have experience defining a technical plan for the delivery of a significant feature or system component with an elegant, simple and extensible design. You write high quality code that is easily understood and used by others.
· You are proficient at making significant changes in a large code base, and have developed a suite of tools and practices that enable you and your team to do so safely.
· Your experience demonstrates that you take ownership of your growth, proactively seeking feedback from your team, your manager, and your stakeholders.
· You have strong verbal and written communication skills that support effective collaboration with our global engineering team.
Experience training and deploying models for production is a nice to have.

 Base Pay Grade - N 

 Equity Grade - 6 

 Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. 

 Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company). 

 CAN base pay range per year: $153,000 - $213,000 

 Location - Remote Canada
 This remote role is open only to candidates residing in Alberta, British Columbia, Manitoba, New Brunswick, Newfoundland and Labrador, Nova Scotia, Ontario, Prince Edward Island, or Saskatchewan. 

 #LI-Remote 

 Remote-first with flexibility built in 
 Affirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

 Benefits designed for you 
 Our benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

- Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.

- Spending stipends: Monthly stipends support your tech setup, and the ability to choose health and wellness options that are right for you.

- Time off to recharge: Flexible time off and generous holiday calendars help you rest when you need to.

- Own a piece of what you build: Our employee stock purchase plan (ESPP) lets you buy Affirm stock at a discount.

 We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

 For positions based in San Francisco or Los Angeles: Affirm considers qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records, as required by law.

 By clicking "Submit Application," you acknowledge that you have read Affirm's Global Candidate Privacy Notice and consent to the use of your personal information as described.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer, InfraSec
jobs.jd:
Who We Are 

 At MongoDB, we are building the future of data platforms with MongoDB Atlas; our fully managed, multi-cloud database service. The Infrastructure Security (InfraSec) team sits within Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) in the CTO organization. We are an engineering team dedicated to building the security infrastructure, primitives, and reusable controls that protect MongoDB Atlas across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud (GCP).

 InfraSec operates on a preventative, enabling model: rather than acting as a manual approval gatekeeper or compliance auditor, we develop automated guardrails and platform capabilities. We integrate security directly into the platform runtime, CI/CD, and Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) workflows so engineering teams can operate securely at scale without friction.

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Dublin for our hybrid working model.

 What You’ll Do 

- Harden hosts and containerized workloads using Linux security mechanisms (AppArmor, SELinux, seccomp, cgroups) and eBPF-based tooling (Cilium, Tetragon)

- Secure containerized infrastructure across multi-cloud environments via RBAC, network policies, admission controls (Gatekeeper), and runtime threat detection.

- Build and manage automated services for Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), workload identity, vulnerability management, and access controls across AWS, Azure, and GCP

- Write production-quality code and leverage Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) to version, test, and deploy security controls as code

- Build real-time security monitoring, logging, and alerting systems to detect anomalies and track security posture at Atlas scale

- Lead initiatives across their full lifecycle; from threat modeling and architectural design to implementation, rollout, and long-term production reliability

 What We’re Looking For 

 Minimum Qualifications: 

- 5+ years in SRE, Infrastructure Engineering, or Cloud Security Engineering

- Strong coding skills in Go (Golang), Python, C, C++, or Rust.

- Proven track record of building and operating large-scale distributed systems or cloud platform infrastructure.

- Hands-on experience using Terraform, CloudFormation, or Ansible for automated infrastructure provisioning.

- Demonstrated experience owning infrastructure in Linux, Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure)

 Preferred Qualifications: 

- Practical experience with eBPF-based security tooling (Cilium, Falco, Tetragon)

- Direct ownership of Cloud Security and Workload Identity platforms

- Multi-cloud expertise spanning AWS, Azure, and GCP

- Production exposure to low-level Linux security mechanisms (seccomp, AppArmor, SELinux, cgroups)

 About MongoDB 

 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the database for the AI era, enabling innovators to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified database platform—the most widely available, globally distributed database on the market—helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud database and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. 

 With offices worldwide and nearly 60,000 customers—including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI-native startups—relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software. 

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB. 

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy , we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB , and help us make an impact on the world! 

 MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter. 

 MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

jobs.title: Senior Principal Engineer, Consumer Experience & Integrity
jobs.jd:
Get to Know the Team 
 Grab operates one of Southeast Asia's most complex digital ecosystems — connecting millions of consumers, drivers, merchants, and partners across mobility, food delivery, e-commerce, financial services, and digital products.
 The Consumer Experience & Integrity (CXI) organisation cuts across this ecosystem, spanning Trust, Safety, Identity, SuperApp architecture, Loyalty & Subscriptions, Agentic Customer Support, Communications, Home Page Personalisation, and Growth.
 We are a team of builders working at the intersection of scale, reliability, and AI-native engineering — solving problems that matter for hundreds of millions of people across Southeast Asia.
 Get to Know the Role 
 We are looking for a Principal Engineer to join CXI as a senior individual contributor with an organisation-wide mandate: transform how we engineer with AI, raise the architectural bar for large-scale distributed systems, and create common platforms that allow teams to move faster with greater autonomy.
 You will partner with senior engineers, engineering leaders, product leaders, and data scientists to drive technical direction across CXI through architectural clarity, deep technical craft, and enabling others to succeed.
 You will report to the Head of Technology, Integrity & COREX.
 
 The Critical Tasks You Will Perform 
 1. Transform the Software Development Lifecycle with AI 
 You will lead CXI's shift from isolated AI tools toward a fully AI-native engineering model by shaping the architecture, platforms, and practices needed to embed AI and autonomous agents throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, operations, and incident response. You will leverage GenAI to design evaluation frameworks, guardrail systems, and context/knowledge systems that make higher-autonomy engineering safe and scalable, enabling teams to operate with faster feedback loops and significantly higher engineering leverage.
 2. Architect Systems for Massive Scale and Reliability 
 
- You will provide architectural leadership for high-throughput, highly available distributed systems powering critical consumer and integrity experiences.

- Using AI-assisted design and analysis tools, you will help teams solve hard problems around scalability, reliability, resilience, performance, security, and cost — establishing architectural patterns that prevent systemic failures rather than solving reliability one incident at a time.
 3. Build Common Platforms Across the Grab Ecosystem 
 
- You will identify where capabilities should remain domain-specific and where they should become shared platform primitives — creating leverage across mobility, food delivery, e-commerce, financial services, and digital products.

- You will use GenAI to accelerate platform design, documentation, and adoption — solving difficult platform problems once and enabling many teams to build on top of them.
 4. Enable Autonomous Teams While Maintaining Architectural Coherence 
 
- You will establish reference architectures, engineering principles, reusable patterns, and technical guardrails that allow teams to make decisions independently.

- For the hardest cross-cutting problems, you will go deeper — helping teams evaluate trade-offs and converge on architectures that work beyond a single use case. Success means teams become more autonomous because of the architecture, not more dependent on you.
 5. Drive Technical Influence Across CXI Leadership 
 
- You will serve as a trusted technical voice for senior engineers, engineering leaders, and product leaders — communicating complex architectural trade-offs clearly, shaping long-term technical strategy, and representing CXI engineering standards in cross-functional and company-wide forums.

- You will use AI tools to synthesise technical signals, model scenarios, and accelerate the preparation of architectural proposals and decision artefacts.

What Essential Skills You Will Need 
 
- You have 15+ years of experience in software engineering and system design , with at least 5 years in a principal engineer or architect role at large-scale technology companies.

- You have hands-on experience driving AI-enabled engineering transformation — including coding agents, agentic workflows, automated testing, evaluation frameworks, and engineering guardrails — and a track record of embedding AI tools into real engineering teams.

- You have architected and scaled large distributed systems serving millions of users with demanding reliability, availability, and performance requirements in production environments.

- You have built or led shared platform capabilities adopted across multiple products, business lines, or engineering organisations, with measurable impact on engineering velocity or system reliability.

- You have led cross-team architectural initiatives and demonstrated the ability to influence senior engineers and engineering leaders without relying on direct reporting authority.

- You have experience engaging with AI tools and emerging technologies to enhance productivity, improve workflows, and contribute new ideas — including using GenAI for design, documentation, code review, and technical analysis at scale.

Life at Grab 
 We care about your well-being at Grab, here are some of the global benefits we offer:
 
- We have your back with Term Life Insurance and comprehensive Medical Insurance. 

- With GrabFlex, create a benefits package that suits your needs and aspirations.

- Celebrate moments that matter in life with loved ones through Parental and Birthday leave , and give back to your communities through Love-all-Serve-all (LASA) volunteering leave

- We have a confidential Grabber Assistance Programme to guide and uplift you and your loved ones through life's challenges.

- Balancing personal commitments and life's demands are made easier with our FlexWork arrangements such as differentiated hours
 What We Stand For

WHO ARE WE?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!



As a Senior Security Operations Engineer you will:

 - Serve as trusted advisor to team’s leadership and partner teams by clearly articulating business risks associated with security issues

 - Harden our cloud-native environments (AWS, OCI, GCP) by introducing secure by default cloud controls

 - Own and drive resolutions for enabling engineers to design, build, and use infrastructure securely at scale by paving the secure path using infrastructure-as-code modules and reusable code libraries

 - Manage IAM / RBAC for cloud infrastructure, and partner with IT on streamlining authentication/authorization to ensure unified access control across the board

 - Deploy, integrate and operationalize security platforms and services including but not limited to SIEM, SOAR, domain monitoring, endpoint tooling, cloud security tooling

 - Respond to security incidents and harden environments post-incidents.

 - Support control monitoring and remediation for compliance initiatives

 - Gather and analyze security metrics to address security issues with cross-team dependencies

 - Partner empathetically with engineering teams to understand their needs and deliver practical, scalable security solutions without creating unnecessary friction.



You may be a good fit if:

 - 5+ years previous experience in SecOps, DevSecOps, Cloud Security, Threat Detection & Response or software development with a strong focus on security engineering.

 - You’re a hands-on security engineer interested in automating controls and building scalable solutions rather than relying on manual processes.

 - You have experience in managing cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI) and Kubernetes environments

 - Familiarity with CI/CD systems and SecOps workflows (Git, Terraform) in cloud environments (GCP, AWS, Azure, OCI)

 - Have practical experience with one or more of : infrastructure automation, network segmentation, system hardening, container and cloud security concepts, and security observability

 - You have experience with multiple languages such as Golang and/or Python

 - Are comfortable navigating ambiguity, making informed decisions with incomplete information, and adapting your approach as requirements evolve.

 - You employ a flexible and constructive approach when solving problems

 - You are able to make trade-offs between build vs. buy decisions - help build solutions and able to review what tools are available

 - You understand secure engineering best practices, can articulate problem statements and propose solutions to both technically savvy and non-technical audiences

jobs.jd:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

 About the Team 

 The Identity & Security team owns the front door to Binance. We build and operate the registration, login, and account security experience used by every one of our 300M+ users — social login, OAuth and third-party authorization, multi-factor authentication, passkeys and FIDO2, device management, account activity, and account closure.

 We are currently building an in-house AI facial recognition security product for KYC verification and user safety, replacing our existing third-party vendor solution. This is a to-C product serving hundreds of millions of users, directly impacting account security and identity verification experience at scale.

 Our work sits where three forces meet: enormous scale, strict security and regulatory constraints, and the reality that one extra verification step can block an attacker or lock out a legitimate user. We ship across web, mobile mini programs, and in-app webviews, and we publish the shared authentication libraries and SDKs that the rest of Binance builds on.

 What You'll Do: 

- Build the in-house AI facial recognition security product end to end — KYC verification, liveness detection, face matching — replacing the existing third-party vendor solution

- Build authentication capabilities end to end: passkeys / FIDO2 (WebAuthn), authenticator apps, security keys, SMS and email verification, and biometric flows

- Own the multi-factor authentication orchestration layer — verification strategy, step-up logic, and user-level customization — balancing security strength against completion rate with measurable outcomes

- Collaborate closely with the AI algorithm team to integrate facial recognition, liveness detection, and other AI model capabilities into the product frontend and backend, building high-concurrency, low-latency online inference services

- Maintain and evolve the shared security component and logic libraries consumed by multiple product applications, and the authentication SDKs published to teams across the company; take responsibility for bundle size, initialization behavior, and backward compatibility

- Develop and operate the Node.js server-side layer: server-side rendering, route-level authentication guards, session validation and redirects, localized routing, and first-paint performance

- Build and refine the BFF layer — aggregating upstream security services and turning raw error codes into results the frontend can consume and users can act on

- Use funnel and event data to find drop-off in login and verification flows, and drive optimization from evidence rather than intuition

- Collaborate closely with product, design, risk, customer support, backend, iOS, and Android teams; independently own the end-to-end design and delivery of a sub-domain such as passkeys, MFA orchestration, or facial recognition verification

 What We're Looking For: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent industry experience

- 3–8 years of frontend or full stack engineering experience, including consumer-facing products taken from zero to one or evolved over multiple years

- Strong web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, browser rendering, networking, caching, and performance optimization

- Production Node.js experience: server-side rendering or isomorphic applications, BFF layering, API aggregation and caching, and the ability to independently debug server-side runtime issues

- A clear methodology for modeling complex flows — authentication and verification are highly branched, stateful, interruptible, and resumable, and need to be abstracted into testable, reusable models rather than nested conditionals

- Solid engineering practice: modular architecture, component design, unit and E2E testing, CI/CD, and responsible judgment on breaking changes to shared libraries (versioning, staged rollout, rollback)

- Proficient with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor / Claude Code / Copilot, etc.) with practical experience incorporating them into daily development workflows

- Fluency in Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.

 Why Binance 

- Shape the future of finance 

- Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure

- Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy

- Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning

- Competitive salary and company benefits

- Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you are a self-starter who thrives on solving complex problems with simple, well-crafted solutions, we want to hear from you.

- Design and implement software solutions that improve quality, performance, and maintainability across major portions of your team's systems, ensuring alignment with long-term architectural goals.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing a design document for a new feature, then jump into a code review where you share feedback with a teammate. After a standup with your team, you spend focused time writing clean, well-tested code for a project you are driving. In the afternoon, you pair with a newer engineer to help them ramp up on a system you helped build, then wrap up by investigating an operational metric that caught your attention during a deployment.

About the team
Our team at Amazon is focused on building reliable, scalable software that directly improves the customer experience.
