jobs.jd:
The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale.

We are seeking a passionate Software Development Engineer who can help us build the next generation of unified Travel & Expense systems and support the AT&E organization.

As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design and build services that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking experiences, automated expense workflows, centralized payment mechanisms, and real-time T&E analytics serving a global customer base. You will collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and senior and peer-level software engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations including Accounts Payable and Global Corporate Procurement. This role provides you with autonomy and ownership over decisions, working backwards directly from customers. There is ample opportunity for growth due to the high-visibility work and presence of senior engineering talent for guidance and mentorship. The team operates in cross-functional two-pizza team structures that lead T&E technical transformations.

You will contribute to a three-tier AI architecture that answers employee policy questions in under 2 seconds with source references, and proactively surfaces policy-compliant recommendations during booking to prevent violations before they occur. You will build modern, mobile-first travel booking and Meetings & Events hub experiences across 45+ countries with real-time validation and calendar integration. You will develop guided workflows, automated data integration pipelines, and conversational agents that significantly reduce expense report submission time and eliminate a meaningful share of expense reports entirely. You will build virtual payment capabilities and central card automation that reduce out-of-pocket employee spend and target zero manual reconciliation. You will develop AI/ML-powered fraud detection models that automate the majority of investigation checks and support transaction-based detection across expanding payment avenues. You will build a single-source T&E analytics platform providing real-time spend insights, policy violation tracking, and cost optimization visibility for managers and finance partners. 

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement scalable service architectures that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking, and automated expense workflows for a global user base.
- Deliver working features across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.
- Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations to translate business needs into reliable technical solutions.

jobs.jd:
Are you passionate about developing real-time, distributed, large-scale services? Like to interact with worldwide advertising customers to build systems that makes advertising and it's functions automated and frictionless? Interested in being part of a worldwide Advertising Engineering team? Then, our Software Development team wants you! We are expanding the Ads Engineering function in Melbourne. So do you want to work for a start up in one of the worlds biggest companies? 

Come join us as an SDE!

Amazon Advertising is looking for a Software Development Engineer who shares Amazon Advertising’s passion for building and delivering a global, scalable, extensible, and secure services to support advertisers. 

You'll become part of a highly motivated team of talented multi-functional builders (front and backend developers) who can collaborate with product managers, technical specialists, and principals across the company. Your team will support the global technology roadmap for our Advertising AI Core Infra technology teams. You should be comfortable with a degree of ambiguity that’s higher than most projects and relish the idea of solving problems that, haven’t been solved at scale before - anywhere. You will encounter challenging, novel situations every day and given the size of this initiative, you’ll have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. We’re looking for self-motivated engineers who are passionate about innovating on behalf of customers, can demonstrate a high degree of teamwork, and want to have fun while they make history and collaborate on beautiful products.

A successful candidate will have strong technical skills, and a history of delivering high quality code to solve complex business problems. Written and verbal communication in this role are critical: you will author narratives that will be consumed by Amazonians at all levels.

Key Technical Challenges:
Distributed and Scalable Architecture: The global Ads Availability team owns Tier 1 critical service infrastructure that forms the backbone of Ad serving. We have enabled this service infrastructure across multiple regions and Availability Zones. 

High Availability: This role will provide critical support to the Global Ads Availability team that owns a key Ads wide Availability framework. It is critical to ensure that this framework remains highly available. High Availability architecture will help us make sure that the system is configured to handle different loads and different failures with minimal or no downtime. 

Security is at the heart of all operations. This role will collaborate with Global teams to ensure Advertising services remain highly secure.

Key job responsibilities
• Business problem is defined. Technology strategy may not be defined.
• Delivers independently, with limited guidance.
• Solves complex software problems. Solutions are extensible and scale. Removes bottlenecks. Makes trade-offs: short-term vs. long-term technical decisions.
• Designs, develops, tests, and deploys software.
• Lead large projects. Knows how to divide so they can work in parallel with other SDEs and reassemble into a cohesive launch.
• 100% AWS Technologies

A day in the life
Your day begins with a quick team stand-up to align on priorities before diving into coding tasks. Throughout the day, you'll collaborate with experienced Amazonians across disciplines, working on designing and building innovative technologies in our large distributed computing environment. You'll participate in code reviews, contribute to technical discussions, and help solve complex problems while working in an agile environment to deliver high-quality software.

About the team
Our growing team in Melbourne is passionate about solving business challenges through innovative technology. We hire the best minds in technology to innovate and build on behalf of our customers, focusing intensely on their needs in everything we do.

The challenges we solve are significant and impact millions of customers, advertisers, and products globally. We're looking for individuals excited by the idea of creating new products, features, and services from scratch while managing ambiguity in an environment where ship cycles are measured in weeks, not years. Our team values collaboration and supports new members with knowledge-sharing and mentorship opportunities.

Basic qualifications:
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications:
- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

 Affirm's engineering team is building a large-scale, highly-available, and global infrastructure that is shared across multiple financial products. Ensuring that our infrastructure is accessible to all engineers is critical to the success of the business. We pride ourselves on our culture across engineering of engaging in thorough technical design review, operational excellence, and capable incident response and analysis.

 The Compute Platform team owns the EKS foundation that Affirm's products run on, from cluster provisioning and lifecycle through the safety standards that keep thousands of workloads reliable at scale. Affirm operates 90+ EKS clusters across environments and regions, and this team is responsible for making that fleet standardized, automated, observable, and self-healing, while establishing and enforcing the workload configuration standards that protect availability. Our mission is to provide a secure, reliable, and scalable Kubernetes platform that lets infrastructure and application teams deploy and operate with confidence and minimal operational friction.

 What you’ll do 

 As a member of the Compute Platform organization, you will collaborate with other teams - including Product, Infrastructure, Traffic, Cost & Capacity Engineering to:

- 
 Architect and evolve Affirm's EKS platform, driving strategy across cluster lifecycle, node management, and shared cluster components

- 
 Lead the technical direction for cluster provisioning, upgrades, and teardown through standardized IaC (Terraform, Spacelift) and self-service workflows

- 
 Own the reliability of core shared components across the fleet (Karpenter, CoreDNS, VPC CNI, Kube Proxy, Metrics Server, etc) and the CI/CD pipeline that ships them consistently

- 
 Define and enforce EKS workload safety standards covering resource configuration, workload isolation and blast radius, disruption tolerance (PDBs), Karpenter consolidation strategies, etc

- 
 Build the enforcement and automation path that moves each standard from research and white-glove onboarding through broad adoption to policy-enforced defaults for new workloads

- 
 Establish the observability, baseline audits, and reporting needed to identify hot spots and measure risk mitigation over time

- 
 Partner with cluster-user teams (checkout, batch, ML, analytics, DevProd, etc) to understand workload needs and shape the platform accordingly

- 
 Drive cost and capacity strategy across node scaling, bin packing, and EC2 instance selection

- 
 Mentor engineers across the Compute Platform teams and set the bar for operational excellence

- 
 Participate in the on-call rotation, triage and catalogue runtime K8s issues, and collaborate with SRE on production incidents

 What we look for 

- 
 Deep EKS and Kubernetes internals expertise, including cluster upgrades, node lifecycle, scheduling, and autoscaling (Karpenter, Cluster Autoscaler)

- 
 Demonstrated experience automating Kubernetes operations at fleet scale, from cluster provisioning, upgrades, and node lifecycle to self-healing remediation and policy-driven enforcement, replacing manual toil with auditable, self-service workflows

- 
 Strong grasp of workload reliability patterns: resource tuning, probes, PDBs, topology and isolation constraints

- 
 Experience designing and enforcing platform standards through policy (admission control, OPA/Gatekeeper or equivalent) and automated frameworks

- 
 Infrastructure as Code fluency with Terraform and a GitOps or pipeline-driven delivery model (ArgoCD, kube-applier, or similar)

- 
 Observability instincts: defining SLOs, building metrics, logs, and alerting coverage, and running data-driven baseline audits

- 
 Cross-functional collaboration skills with platform, product, SRE, and capacity teams

- 
 Demonstrated mentorship and technical leadership across teams

- 
 Drive to track emerging Kubernetes community best practices and adapt them to Affirm's needs

 Qualifications 

- 
 10+ years in software or infrastructure engineering with proven delivery of complex platform solutions

- 
 6+ years hands-on operating production Kubernetes at scale, ideally EKS on AWS

- 
 Strong cloud-native architecture experience on AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, EKS)

- 
 Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Spacelift a plus) and GitOps-style deployment pipelines

- 
 Expert-level proficiency in Go or Python and a proven track record building production-grade Kubernetes controllers, operators, and platform tooling that other engineering teams depend on

- 
 Track record designing and enforcing standards across many teams without becoming a bottleneck

- 
 Exceptional problem-solving and systems-thinking skills

- 
 Demonstrated leadership and cross-functional influence

- 
 Excellent communication skills

jobs.jd:
About Us 

 Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Overview

 Develop and maintain the backend capabilities of the Reach Platform across push notifications, SMS, email, and other messaging channels. Work closely with Compliance, Security, Product, Frontend, QA, and third-party providers to support message delivery across the company's global sites.

Responsibilities

- 
 Develop the Reach Platform backend and its core capabilities across push notifications, SMS, email, WhatsApp, and other messaging channels. Own architecture design, feature development, performance optimization, reliability, and day-to-day operations for the delivery chain.

- 
 Build unified, reliable, efficient, and scalable messaging infrastructure for multiple sites and business lines. Core capabilities include message intake, task scheduling, user routing, channel selection, provider management, frequency limits and safeguards against erroneous sends, priority scheduling, delivery status callbacks, reporting, and effectiveness analysis. Ensure timely and reliable delivery at high volume and under high concurrency.

jobs.jd:
The Role 
 We're building the runtime infrastructure that powers Moveworks' AI agents — the systems that orchestrate, execute, and deliver agent responses to millions of enterprise users in real time. This role sits where large language models meet distributed systems. You'll apply machine learning, LLM, and distributed systems expertise to make agents plan, reason, and use tools reliably, and you'll build the production systems that run those agents at enterprise scale.

Our AI agents can plan, execute multi-step workflows, call tools, wait on human input, and resume — all while maintaining correctness, observability, and low latency. The systems that make this possible are what you'll build and own.

 What you get to do in this role: 
 
- Agent orchestration engine — A state machine that manages long-running agent sessions, coordinating planning, execution, and user interaction across multiple LLM calls and tool invocations

- Model routing and adaptation — Choose, route between, and fine-tune or distill LLMs for specific agent tasks. Meet enterprise requirements such as granular permissions, data freshness, explainability, and preserving general knowledge.

- Distributed session management — Lease-based ownership using conditional writes, heartbeat protocols, and crash recovery via checkpointing

- Event-driven message pipeline — FIFO queues for ordered delivery, consumers for event processing, and real-time streaming via gRPC and Socket.IO 

- Structured concurrency — Running multiple concurrent tasks per session with fail-fast semantics and graceful cancellation

- Observability infrastructure — OpenTelemetry instrumentation, distributed trace context propagation across async boundaries, custom span lifecycle management for sessions that span minutes

- Caching and state layers — Redis, DynamoDB KV stores with per-org/per-bot scoping, batch read optimization, and hot-reload configuration

- Tool and agent connectivity for LLMs: Build MCP and agent-to-agent (A2A) capabilities, including tool discovery, namespacing, and tool selection over large tool catalogs, so the LLM picks and calls the right tool from thousands of candidates.

- Token efficiency and context engineering — Lower the agent's cost and latency through prompt and context discipline, caching, speculative and parallel model-call scheduling, and reducing tokens spent across multi-step LLM reasoning chains.

- Open-weights model adoption and evaluation — Quickly stand up newly released open-weights LLMs at different quantization levels, run them in a test environment, and benchmark their accuracy, latency and cost on agent tasks. Use the results to decide which models reach production.

To be successful in this role you have: 
 You should have deep experience in at least 3 of these areas: 
 
- Distributed systems: consistency models, idempotency, exactly-once delivery, distributed locking/leasing

- Concurrent/async programming: Python asyncio, Go goroutines, structured concurrency, cancellation handling

- Event-driven architectures: message queues (SQS, Kafka), pub/sub, backpressure, delivery guarantees

- Database systems for infrastructure: DynamoDB (conditional writes, transactions), Redis (connection pooling, pub/sub)

- Observability: OpenTelemetry, distributed tracing, span context propagation, Prometheus metrics

- gRPC/protobuf: streaming RPCs, service interface design, error handling patterns

- Machine learning: Large language models, natural language processing, LLM evaluation

 Required: 
 
- 5+ years building production backend/infrastructure systems

- Strong in Python or Go (ideally both)

- Experience designing and operating systems that handle real traffic at scale

- Hands-on experience building production systems that use LLMs or other ML models

- Comfort with ambiguity — these are novel problems without textbook solutions

 Relevant past experience: 
 
- Building and shipping products on large language models with techniques such as RAG, chain-of-thought, self-reflection, tool and function calling, and agentic reasoning.

- Training, fine-tuning, or evaluating machine learning models on large datasets in production, especially for NLP, retrieval, or ranking.

- Improving relevance or quality through careful experimentation: designing metrics, building evaluation datasets, and developing new features and signals for ranking or model selection.

- Research or applied work in machine learning, LLMs, agentic systems, information retrieval, or ranking and relevance.

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 The Okta Secures AI Team 

 The Okta Secures AI Team is building the future of digital identity management. The way companies are using agents and allowing them access is undergoing a fundamental shift, enabling teams to move fast while staying secure. 

 Our North Star is clear: To get AI right, you have to get identity right. We are not just managing identities; we are building the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. As organizations rapidly deploy AI, these non-human entities are acting with access to critical tools, often bypassing traditional perimeters and creating a 'Shadow AI' crisis. Our mission is to move identity from a reactive gatekeeper to a unified control plane, transforming AI risk into business ROI.

 We are tackling this by implementing a comprehensive four-pillar maturity model: Discover, Onboard, Protect, and Govern. We are driving innovation by defining the standards for Agent Identity—including pioneer work with the AI Agent Tool Registry and support for protocols like MCP and IPSIE. You will be helping us build the infrastructure that allows enterprises to scale AI safely, ensuring every access decision—whether made by a human or an automated agent—is authenticated, authorized, and audited at scale.

 We are a diverse team of engineers, product managers, and designers who are bringing Okta’s expertise in identity to define the future of Agent Identity management, focusing on enablement while staying secure.

 The Staff FullStack Engineer Opportunity 

 As a Staff Fullstack Engineer on the Okta Secures AI team, your mission is to build the industry's first Identity Security Fabric for the agentic era. jobs.jd:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.



We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.



Here’s what this particular role covers.



🛠️ About our AI Platform Teams

Our AI Platform teams build the infrastructure that powers Wayve’s embodied AI. We store and serve hundreds of petabytes of driving data, growing towards exabyte scale, to support model training, simulation and data pipelines across regions and clouds.

As our first dedicated Staff Software Engineer for Storage Platform, you’ll set the technical direction for how we manage, protect and serve this data. Working closely with Infrastructure, Security, Privacy, Data Engineering and ML teams, you’ll help make training more efficient while reducing one of Wayve’s largest infrastructure costs.

 

🧠 Your day-to-day

 - Lead a hands-on, multi-quarter storage programme, from defining the problems and architecture to delivering platforms that teams adopt.

 - Build production services, controllers and infrastructure using Python, Go or a similar language, alongside Kubernetes and Terraform.

 - Partner with ML and data teams to understand access patterns, remove storage bottlenecks and reduce the time GPUs spend waiting for data.

 - Work with Security and Privacy to strengthen access controls, auditing and safe deletion of vehicle-collected data.

 - Write design documents and RFCs, align teams around shared standards, and mentor engineers as the platform and team grow.

 

🧩 What you’ll be working on

 - Data ownership and governance: Give datasets clear owners, purposes and retention classes, with tagging and team-level cost attribution.

 - Safe lifecycle management: Build retention, deletion and re-tiering capabilities for Azure Blob, backed by dry runs, audit trails and recovery paths.

 - Read performance and caching: Improve throughput and latency by tackling small-object reads, throttling, unnecessary data access and cross-region hops.

 - Secure data movement: Design Kubernetes-native NVMe caching and secure replication across regions and clouds.

 - Measurable platform outcomes: Establish standards, dashboards and SLOs for availability, performance, cache effectiveness, storage tiers and cost.



🙌 You should apply if

 - You’ve operated at Staff Engineer scope, leading complex infrastructure programmes across multiple teams from problem definition through adoption.

 - You’ve owned petabyte-scale object storage end to end—including data layout, lifecycle management, performance and cost—with measurable outcomes against a cost target.

 - You’ve built scalable systems for data ownership, tagging, cataloguing, retention or deletion.

 - You bring strong security and access-management experience, including IAM/RBAC, encryption, secure replication and auditing.

 - You’re a hands-on software engineer with strong Python, Go or comparable skills, plus production Kubernetes, Terraform and CI experience. You build durable platforms and services, not just one-off scripts.

 - You can influence technical decisions without formal authority, mentor others and are excited to start in a founding, hands-on role with the opportunity to grow a team.

 - You can work on a hybrid basis from our London office.

Experience with AWS or GCP is welcome—you don’t need to have worked exclusively with Azure.

 

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

 

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

 

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

 

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

 - Initial call / recruiter screen (30 mins) - A conversation with our Talent Partner about your experience, interest in the role and practical details.

 - Competency Interviews (60 mins) - A programming interview to assess your hands-on software engineering skills.

 - Deep-dive technical interviews - A system design interview and a domain-specific interview

1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $500M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing.



About 1Password

At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work.



If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future.



The Billing & Payments Engineering team builds and owns the mission-critical systems that power 1Password’s revenue engine end-to-end. We are responsible for the highly available architecture that enables seamless subscription management, complex payment processing, and global financial compliance. From managing the intricate logic of the subscription lifecycle—creations, renewals, upgrades, and cancellations—to integrating with diverse payment gateways and app-store ecosystems, our work ensures a frictionless experience for our customers. As a team, we are actively architecting the next generation of our billing infrastructure, modernizing and consolidating our systems to support rapidly scaling product lines, guarantee absolute data integrity, and ensure robust integrations with downstream financial workflows.



In this role, you’ll design, build, and operate reliable backend services while owning complex initiatives from initial design through production. Your work will help create a safer, simpler digital future by making it easier for customers to access and rely on 1Password.



How we’re using AI today

Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers.



This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US.



What we're looking for:

 - Demonstrated expertise in engineering robust backend architectures using Go, alongside a history of taking end-to-end ownership of complex initiatives from initial design to live production deployment

 - A drive for and proven experience in software development best practices, and coding standards

 - You enjoy solving complex problems with a demonstrated ability propose effective solutions

 - You like communicating and collaborating and can demonstrate experience in working effectively with team and communicating technical concepts to non-technical cross-functional partners

 - You’re passionate about testing methodologies and debugging techniques to ensure high-quality code



Bonus points for:

 - Billing & Payments: Experience building or maintaining billing, payment processing, or subscription platforms (e.g., Stripe, native app stores).

 - Distributed Systems: A strong background in designing and scaling highly available, fault-tolerant distributed architectures.

 - API Integrations: Proven ability to build resilient integrations with third-party APIs, including handling webhooks, retries, and strict idempotency.



What you can expect:

 - Code, test, debug, deliver and maintain production software systems for new and existing product features

 - Collaborate with cross functional teams and/or stakeholders throughout the development cycle to ensure smooth releases

 - Work with your teammates and project manager to communicate technical requirements to stakeholders and solve technical problems in a scalable and realistic way

 - Mentor junior and new team members by helping them understand team expectations, providing technical guidance, sharing knowledge, and engaging in pair programming sessions

 - Participate in planning by identifying major tasks and breaking down, estimating, and planning work

 - Write comprehensive tests during various stages of the development cycle, ensuring code is functioning as expected

 - Review code for others to maintain high code quality, knowledge share within the team, and support creating a safe environment of giving and receiving feedback

 - Generate and review documentation on code processes to ensure scalability

 - Stay informed about the latest industry trends, technologies, and best practices in development

 - Be available for on-call rotational work to ensure uninterrupted support and resolve emergencies



USA-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $153,000 USD and $214,000 USD, plus immediate participation in 1Password's benefits program (health, dental, 401k and many others), utilization of our generous paid time off, an equity grant and, where applicable, participation in our incentive programs.



Canada-based roles only: The annual base salary for this role is between $144,000 CAD

We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our growing AI organization in Vancouver. Asana is pioneering a new category of technology as the human-agent operating system, doubling down on our AI Suite to move our customers toward expansive, end-to-end intelligent orchestration. We are expanding several of our key AI engineering teams: depending on where you land, you might lead architecture across our core agentic runtime, develop high-throughput evaluation and safety infrastructure, or build the sophisticated customer-facing builders and canvas surfaces that allow enterprises to coordinate humans and AI agents seamlessly. Because this is an organization-wide search across our AI teams, you will participate in a single, streamlined technical interview process, and we will work with you to match you to the ideal team at the end of your interview experience.

 This role is based in our Vancouver office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on Wednesdays. Working from home on Fridays depends on the type of work you do and the teams with which you partner. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.

 What you’ll achieve 

- Drive the technical design, architecture, and end-to-end delivery of medium-to-large projects across our AI roadmap, guiding and collaborating with multiple engineers.

- Design robust, extensible, and performant systems that support agentic execution, prompt-driven automation, model orchestration, and strict enterprise-grade data boundaries.

- Solve complex technical problems by weighing technical debt, developer velocity, execution risk, and direct business goals.

- Anticipate customer and architectural risks early, breaking down complex, ambiguous product visions into clear engineering milestones and actionable tasks.

- Champion technical excellence, write high-leverage design docs, run meaningful retrospectives, establish testing norms, and mentor engineers across levels to raise the engineering bar.

- Partner closely with Product Managers, Engineering Managers, Product Designers, and Data Scientists to define requirements, clarify trade-offs, and align technical direction with Asana's broader product strategy.

 About you 

- Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.

- 6+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and maintaining production distributed systems, microservices, or complex full-stack architectures.

- Demonstrated track record of technical leadership across multiple services or codebases, with practical experience or deep interest in LLMs, agentic patterns, evaluation pipelines, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or real-time streaming infrastructure.

- Proven ability to author comprehensive technical design docs, evaluate trade-offs (e.g., latency, cost, determinism, maintainability), and make durable architectural decisions.

- Track record of acting as a Tech Lead or Area of Responsibility (AoR) owner—successfully driving multi-contributor projects from ambiguity to delivery while navigating cross-team dependencies.

- Passion for mentoring and coaching fellow engineers, providing actionable code and design feedback, and establishing long-term engineering best practices.

- Deep empathy for the end-user experience, understanding how backend architecture and model behaviours directly affect user trust, interface latency, and workflow reliability.

 Okta is The World’s Identity Company.  At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences. 

 Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

 The Product

- Deep expertise in applied AI/ML, including generative AI, LLMs, and agent-based frameworks.

- Demonstrated ability to solve complex, ambiguous problems and thrive in rapidly changing environments.

- Strong communication and collaboration skills, with experience influencing cross-functional teams without formal authority.

- Experience with AI risk assessment, data privacy, and compliance (e.g., GDPR).

- Strategic and innovative thinking, with a track record of aligning technical solutions to business goals.

 It's great, but not required, if you have:

- Familiarity with regulated industries (e.g., finance, healthcare).

- Experience deploying AI solutions to complex production systems at scale.

- Prior experience mentoring or leading engineering teams.

 - Enhancing telemetry pipelines to extract AWS-specific metrics from managed services and route actionable alerts directly to product squads.

 - Implementing chaos engineering scenarios to test infrastructure failure modes, alongside building API load shedding and rate limiting to protect services against traffic surges.

 - You bring a solid background in site reliability engineering or DevOps, with experience diagnosing and strengthening distributed systems.

 - You have practical experience managing containerised workloads in Kubernetes and running infrastructure on cloud platforms such as AWS.

 - Your skillset includes practical coding proficiency in Golang, Python, or C#, coupled with curiosity for applying modern AI tools to operational challenges.

 - You display strong agency and initiative, proactively identifying operational friction and proposing sustainable technical solutions without waiting for instruction.

 - You possess clear communication skills, consistently linking technical reliability investments directly to customer needs and measurable business outcomes.

Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

 As a Senior Software Engineer on the team, you will own capacity and efficiency for Robinhood's storage and database fleet, from Aurora clusters to S3 and the caches and volumes in between. You will build the systems that size this fleet to demand: Aurora reader counts and writer sizes set from market hours, declared events, and live load instead of fixed schedules; databases, caches, and volumes rightsized to what they actually use; and S3 data kept in the right storage class, with lifecycle rules that keep growth in check. You will take each from recommendations the Storage team validates to automation that safely applies its own changes in production. This is a 0-to-1 build with measurable impact on reliability at market peaks and on the AWS bill.

 This role is based in our Bellevue, WA office , with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week .

- Design and build a capacity planner for Aurora that sets reader counts and writer instance sizes from demand and load signals (IOPS, CPU, connections, replica lag), replacing fixed scaling schedules

- Rightsize databases, caches, and block storage (RDS, ElastiCache, DynamoDB, EBS) on instance size, provisioned IOPS and throughput, and idle capacity, and keep them right-sized as load changes

About Team 
 Flow by ServiceNow is a standalone conversational AI service desk, with its own product and its own codebase. Employees ask for help wherever they already work — Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, or the browser. Flow answers from connected knowledge, handles the request, and runs automations the team publishes. AI is how the product works, and a person stays in control when the action is sensitive. 
 Flow is a new company inside ServiceNow, reimagining every function from first principles. We hire builders with agency and curiosity who use AI as the default way to design, review, and operate. They challenge inherited ways of working and treat their work as craft. 
 Flow is only as good as the systems it can read and the actions it can take. On the Integrations team, you’ll own how Flow connects to the systems companies run on, including identity, devices, ticketing, documents, and chat. You’ll turn them into three things: assets Flow can inventory, knowledge it can cite, and actions it can run. Every connection keeps each source’s permissions intact. 
 In your first 12 months, you’ll make sure priority systems support assets, automations, and knowledge that Flow can actually use. Connection health and failed actions will be operable without a specialist in the room, and every new system will follow one contract for permissions, audit, and proof. 
 Types of problems you’ll get to work on 
 
- Integration generation at scale. We don’t hand-write connectors. Build the pipeline that generates them from whatever a vendor publishes, which is often not a clean OpenAPI spec — and own spec normalization, pinned provenance, and deterministic regeneration across a growing catalog. 

- Tool surfaces an AI can actually call. An action’s name, description, schema, and examples are the product surface a model sees. Design them so the assistant picks the right action first try, scope them so they are safe for an AI to call, and measure whether it does. 

- Permissions and credentials you can prove. If a file is private to HR, a marketer must not see its title, its URL, or that it exists. Own access-model mirroring and delete detection, and pick the smallest credential policy each provider needs across validation, reconnect, revocation, and tenant isolation. 

- AI-native development itself. Agentic coding is how this team ships, not a productivity add-on. Author the skills and guardrails that let agents do integration work correctly, keep the deterministic provider-fake harness that makes fast iteration possible, and review generated code critically before anything ships. 

- Engineering leadership. Raise the technical bar through architecture decisions, code review, and coaching. Partner with product and design to shape requirements and explain tradeoffs clearly. 

 Our stack 
 TypeScript on Bun, PostgreSQL, Temporal for durable execution, Nango as the OAuth broker. We expect you to be excellent in a comparable stack and fluent in ours within weeks. We are not screening for this list.

To be successful in this role you have: 
 
- Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This includes current, hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development. 

- 8+ years of software engineering with strong fundamentals in system design, API design, relational data modeling, and testing. 

- Hands-on depth building and operating third-party integrations that real tenants depended on — webhooks, rate limits, pagination, incremental sync, delete detection. 

- Experience designing API or SDK surfaces that another system consumes correctly without a human reading the documentation — and interest in doing that for a model. 

- Ownership of a versioned contract where a rename breaks a customer: stable identifiers, deprecation, and migration. 

- Sound judgment about least-privilege access — scope minimization per action, admin consent, secrets handling, tenant isolation — and about which actions an AI may take on its own. 

- Comfort with ambiguity and the drive to build from 0–1 without a playbook. 

- A record of technical leadership: architecture ownership, code-quality bar-raising, and mentoring engineers. 

 Nice to have 
 
- Experience evaluating tool or function selection — measuring whether a model picks the right action. 

- Experience with RAG or the Model Context Protocol (MCP). 

- Familiarity with SCIM or directory sync. 

- Background in IT service management or employee support products. 

 Why join us 
 Intelligence is commoditizing. Connection and execution are not. A model that reasons brilliantly and cannot act on the systems a company actually runs is a demo. 
 Flow already reaches a broad and growing share of the systems enterprises run day to day, and this team decides how fast that surface grows and how far each connection can be trusted. We aren’t writing connectors one at a time. We’re building the generator, the contract every provider follows, and the proof that what Flow says it did, it actually did. Real problems: a vendor specification that lies, an access model that must be mirrored exactly or not at all, a sync that resumes cleanly a million items later, and a tool surface a model has to get right without reading the documentation.

 Python FastAPI, AWS Step Functions, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Lambda, SQS, EventBridge, API Gateway and containers. Data and security use RDS PostgreSQL, pgvector, S3 Object Lock, KMS, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch and CloudTrail. The frontend uses React and AWS Amplify.

- Multi-tenant SaaS, OAuth, OIDC, SAML, SCIM or enterprise connector development.

jobs.title: Senior Engineer, Competitive Benchmarking & Performance
jobs.jd:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

 What is The Role 

 Elasticsearch powers search, observability, and AI retrieval (RAG) for the world's largest organizations. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to lead competitive benchmarking initiatives within the Elasticsearch Performance team. 

 You will develop representative workloads, automate reproducible experiments, and investigate how Elasticsearch compares with alternative systems. Your work will identify performance strengths, gaps, and tradeoffs, guide engineering improvements, and help customers make informed technical decisions.

 This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building benchmarks and investigating performance, with technical publishing as a shared responsibility alongside engineering and content partners.

 A typical investigation might ask how Elasticsearch and an alternative system compare under concurrent ingestion and hybrid search, at comparable retrieval quality and cost, and which engineering changes would improve the outcome. This role offers the opportunity to connect deep performance analysis with product improvements and public technical work.

 What You Will Be Doing 

- Own prioritized competitive benchmarking initiatives across search, vector and hybrid retrieval, and analytical and observability workloads.

- Build and maintain automated benchmark harnesses, datasets, query sets, and load profiles that reflect real-world usage, including concurrent ingestion and querying.

- Design fair comparisons with documented system versions, configurations, tuning decisions, resource budgets, and functional differences.

- Evaluate latency distributions, throughput, resource consumption, and cost efficiency. For retrieval workloads, measure performance at comparable recall or relevance targets.

- Adapt and extend workload-appropriate tools such as Elasticsearch Rally, ClickBench, and vector search benchmark frameworks.

- Investigate performance differences using profiling, system metrics, and controlled experiments; collaborate with engineering teams to identify causes and validate improvements.

- Evaluate relevant self-managed and managed cloud deployments, including serverless offerings, accounting for scaling behavior and service constraints.

- Work with engineering and technical content partners to publish reproducible benchmark artifacts and clear technical reports that explain methodology, findings, limitations, and tradeoffs.

- Partner with engineering and product management to prioritize benchmark coverage and translate findings into actionable product improvements.

What You Bring 

- Solid software engineering skills, with experience building maintainable automation and analysis tools in Python or another relevant programming language.

- Hands-on experience evaluating and diagnosing performance in distributed systems, databases, or search infrastructure.

- Depth in at least one relevant area (search, vector retrieval, analytical databases, or observability systems) and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.

- Experience designing representative datasets and workloads, including query patterns, concurrency, and ingestion behavior.

- Sound experimental judgment, including repeated measurements, variability analysis, warm-up and cache effects, and the distinction between meaningful changes and measurement noise.

- Experience building reproducible test environments and documenting configurations, procedures, and results.

- Clear technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex findings and their limitations.

- Solid collaboration skills and the ability to turn performance evidence into applicable engineering recommendations.

Bonus Points

- Experience with Elasticsearch, Lucene, Rally, ClickBench, or vector search benchmark frameworks.

- Experience measuring retrieval quality alongside latency, throughput, and resource usage.

- Familiarity with cloud performance and cost analysis, including autoscaling and serverless systems.

- Public technical writing, open-source contributions, or published benchmark studies.

 Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. 

 At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

 The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.

 What is The Role 

 Elasticsearch powers search, observability, and AI retrieval (RAG) for the world's largest organizations. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to lead competitive benchmarking initiatives within the Elasticsearch Performance team. 

 You will develop representative workloads, automate reproducible experiments, and investigate how Elasticsearch compares with alternative systems. Your work will identify performance strengths, gaps, and tradeoffs, guide engineering improvements, and help customers make informed technical decisions.

 This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building benchmarks and investigating performance, with technical publishing as a shared responsibility alongside engineering and content partners.

 A typical investigation might ask how Elasticsearch and an alternative system compare under concurrent ingestion and hybrid search, at comparable retrieval quality and cost, and which engineering changes would improve the outcome. This role offers the opportunity to connect deep performance analysis with product improvements and public technical work.

 What You Will Be Doing 

- Own prioritized competitive benchmarking initiatives across search, vector and hybrid retrieval, and analytical and observability workloads.

- Build and maintain automated benchmark harnesses, datasets, query sets, and load profiles that reflect real-world usage, including concurrent ingestion and querying.

- Design fair comparisons with documented system versions, configurations, tuning decisions, resource budgets, and functional differences.

- Evaluate latency distributions, throughput, resource consumption, and cost efficiency. For retrieval workloads, measure performance at comparable recall or relevance targets.

- Adapt and extend workload-appropriate tools such as Elasticsearch Rally, ClickBench, and vector search benchmark frameworks.

- Investigate performance differences using profiling, system metrics, and controlled experiments; collaborate with engineering teams to identify causes and validate improvements.

- Evaluate relevant self-managed and managed cloud deployments, including serverless offerings, accounting for scaling behavior and service constraints.

- Work with engineering and technical content partners to publish reproducible benchmark artifacts and clear technical reports that explain methodology, findings, limitations, and tradeoffs.

- Partner with engineering and product management to prioritize benchmark coverage and translate findings into actionable product improvements.

What You Bring 

- Solid software engineering skills, with experience building maintainable automation and analysis tools in Python or another relevant programming language.

- Hands-on experience evaluating and diagnosing performance in distributed systems, databases, or search infrastructure.

- Depth in at least one relevant area (search, vector retrieval, analytical databases, or observability systems) and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.

- Experience designing representative datasets and workloads, including query patterns, concurrency, and ingestion behavior.

- Sound experimental judgment, including repeated measurements, variability analysis, warm-up and cache effects, and the distinction between meaningful changes and measurement noise.

- Experience building reproducible test environments and documenting configurations, procedures, and results.

- Clear technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex findings and their limitations.

- Solid collaboration skills and the ability to turn performance evidence into applicable engineering recommendations.

Bonus Points

- Experience with Elasticsearch, Lucene, Rally, ClickBench, or vector search benchmark frameworks.

- Experience measuring retrieval quality alongside latency, throughput, and resource usage.

- Familiarity with cloud performance and cost analysis, including autoscaling and serverless systems.

- Public technical writing, open-source contributions, or published benchmark studies.

 Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component. 

 At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.

 The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.

AWS Lambda’s goal is nothing less than to simplify and improve the experience of computing in the cloud for every developer on the planet, from start-ups to the largest Fortune 100 companies. Serverless computing is rapidly changing how every company thinks about building and delivering software solutions, and Lambda is leading this industry wide effort.

Our Team

AWS Lambda is growing its initiatives in Dublin, Ireland, with goals of continuing to define the Serverless revolution. Lambda teams in Dublin are part of lambda experience charter with mission to simplify the developer, operator, and administrator tasks in bringing code from desktop-development to a production service. If you’re excited by Serverless computing, programming languages and container/function interaction models, this role is for you. Join us and change how the world computes by enabling new frameworks that enable customers to build better software on top of AWS.

Lambda Experience Runtimes is one of the most customer visible and developer commented upon areas of Lambda. The Language Runtimes team are responsible for the curation, patching and deprecation of all the six Managed Runtimes that Lambda supports such as Python, NodeJS, Java, Ruby, Go, DotNet in addition to the custom runtime plus the associated lambda container images.

An ideal candidate has experience delivering new initiatives and be comfortable working closely with Customers. You should be aware of industry best practices & patterns in all aspects of building, releasing & verifying software. You should also be familiar with industry trends in programming languages, build tooling, and deployment spaces. You will own and help driving exciting new and existing initiatives in Lambda, while being capable of working on massive scale, high availability, and ambiguous performance problems as well as developer experience problems. This role will involve identifying and solving problems in different programming language ecosystems, enabling new customer facing functionality, and new programming paradigms in the Serverless ecosystem.

What does it take to succeed in this role?

A roll-up-your-sleeves type. Comfortable working in an environment dedicated to meeting the expectations and requirements of customers. Able to think about business opportunities, operational issues, and architectural diagrams in the course of a single conversation. Intellectually curious, always looking to learn, and a dedication to turning developers into fans. Someone who makes the team both productive and a fun place to work. Being excited to learn from others while bringing your own novel capabilities and perspectives.

On-Call Responsibility

This position involves on-call responsibilities, every builder on Lambda is also an owner. Nobody likes to get paged in the middle of the night or on the weekend, so we work to ensure that our systems are well engineered, fault tolerant and meet a high quality bar before the go into production. Our customers expect nothing less. When we do get paged we work together as a team to resolve the root cause of the issue and nobody is left on their own to deal with an operational issue.

What you should expect?

If you’re excited by defining how modern and future software applications are built and want to help lead from the innovative edge, we guarantee that your work in our team will be ground-breaking and challenging. We’re looking for a new teammate who is enthusiastic, empathetic, curious, motivated, reliable, and able to work effectively with a diverse team of peers; someone who will help us amplify the positive & inclusive team culture we’ve been building.

Together, we’ll deliver the next generation of industry-leading compute features and help every business from the smallest startups to the largest enterprises run their code in the cloud without the burden of infrastructure or scale (that’s our job). We’ll shape not just our own products, but contribute to the direction of AWS and the serverless industry.

Utility Computing (UC)
AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS. Within AWS UC, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) roles engage with AWS customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Come help us change the world!

jobs.jd:
About Anthropic 

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

 Platform Safety builds the infrastructure that lets Anthropic bring its most capable models to more people, safely and securely. Our systems decide both who can access our most advanced models, and what capabilities they can access, wherever Claude is available. That includes identity and business verification, trusted access programs, and the core services that grant, hold and enforce model access across our products. These systems already power the Cyber Verification Program, which now includes Project Glasswing, and the Life Sciences Verification Program with further more advanced use cases in development.

 As a Staff+ engineer, you'll help set the technical direction for this work. The foundations are live and adoption is growing quickly, so the next challenge is scale: making access a matter of configuration instead of code, making verification reusable, and giving customers a consistent experience on every surface. You'll work closely with safeguards, product, design and research to turn safety policy into systems that are easy to use and enforce. You'll also take new 0 → 1 efforts from idea to delivery as new capabilities and programs emerge.

What you'll do

 You'll design, build and operate the systems that decide who gets access to our most capable models. You'll build the platform that lets teams across Anthropic launch and run trusted access programs, moving access rules out of code and into data so that launching a new model or complex program is simple and scalable. You'll build out our identity and business verification system (KYC/KYB) as a reusable service that any program can use, which means integrating verification vendors, protecting sensitive personal data, expanding into new regions, and building fair review and appeal paths for customers. You'll also evolve the core services behind every access decision, including the services that grant and hold access and the customer and user identity models they rely on, and keep them highly available and consistent across our own products and cloud platforms.

 You'll shape the architecture through clear written proposals, review key designs, and mentor engineers on a growing team. You'll also share on-call, lead incident response, and support emerging new programs.

You might be a good fit if you:

- Have a minimum of 8 years of practical experience as a backend or platform engineer, ideally at tech lead level or equivalent, and are comfortable working across the stack when the problem calls for it

- Have strong product sense, and work closely with cross-functional partners, including non-engineers, to shape and execute strategy in new domains

- Use AI tools as a regular part of how you design, build and review software

- Have designed and operated production distributed systems on a critical path, where correctness, latency and availability all matter

- Take full ownership of your work, from design through build, deployment, operations and iteration

- Navigate ambiguity and make sound technical decisions independently, have set technical direction that other engineers and teams adopted, and have ideally operated in both 0 → 1 and more mature settings

- Care about building robust, scalable systems that other engineers and businesses love to use

- Care about the societal impacts of your work and Anthropic's mission to build safe, beneficial AI

 Strong candidates may also have: 

- Identity, access control or authorization systems at scale

- Fraud, risk, trust and safety, or KYC/KYB systems, including working with verification vendors

- Regulated or compliance-sensitive environments, including handling sensitive personal data

- Integrating with cloud platforms or partner ecosystems such as AWS, Google Cloud and Azure

 Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. 

 Location Preference: Preference will be given to candidates based in NY, SEA, SF or the Bay Area given the current location of team.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer (Web,Frontend Oriented) — AI Facial Recognition, Identity & Security
jobs.location: Australia; Hong Kong; New Zealand; Singapore; Taiwan; United Arab Emirates | United Arab Emirates
jobs.jd:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, and more. Our mission is to increase the freedom of money and financial access for people around the world.

 About the Team 

 The Identity & Security team owns the front door to Binance. We build and operate the registration, login, and account security experience used by every one of our 300M+ users — social login, OAuth and third-party authorization, multi-factor authentication, passkeys and FIDO2, device management, account activity, and account closure.

 We are currently building an in-house AI facial recognition security product for KYC verification and user safety, replacing our existing third-party vendor solution. This is a to-C product serving hundreds of millions of users, directly impacting account security and identity verification experience at scale.

 Our work sits where three forces meet: enormous scale, strict security and regulatory constraints, and the reality that one extra verification step can block an attacker or lock out a legitimate user. We ship across web, mobile mini programs, and in-app webviews, and we publish the shared authentication libraries and SDKs that the rest of Binance builds on.

 What You'll Do: 

- Build the in-house AI facial recognition security product end to end — KYC verification, liveness detection, face matching — replacing the existing third-party vendor solution

- Build authentication capabilities end to end: passkeys / FIDO2 (WebAuthn), authenticator apps, security keys, SMS and email verification, and biometric flows

- Own the multi-factor authentication orchestration layer — verification strategy, step-up logic, and user-level customization — balancing security strength against completion rate with measurable outcomes

- Collaborate closely with the AI algorithm team to integrate facial recognition, liveness detection, and other AI model capabilities into the product frontend and backend, building high-concurrency, low-latency online inference services

- Maintain and evolve the shared security component and logic libraries consumed by multiple product applications, and the authentication SDKs published to teams across the company; take responsibility for bundle size, initialization behavior, and backward compatibility

- Develop and operate the Node.js server-side layer: server-side rendering, route-level authentication guards, session validation and redirects, localized routing, and first-paint performance

- Build and refine the BFF layer — aggregating upstream security services and turning raw error codes into results the frontend can consume and users can act on

- Use funnel and event data to find drop-off in login and verification flows, and drive optimization from evidence rather than intuition

- Collaborate closely with product, design, risk, customer support, backend, iOS, and Android teams; independently own the end-to-end design and delivery of a sub-domain such as passkeys, MFA orchestration, or facial recognition verification

 What We're Looking For: 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent industry experience

- 3–8 years of frontend or full stack engineering experience, including consumer-facing products taken from zero to one or evolved over multiple years

- Strong web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, browser rendering, networking, caching, and performance optimization

- Production Node.js experience: server-side rendering or isomorphic applications, BFF layering, API aggregation and caching, and the ability to independently debug server-side runtime issues

- A clear methodology for modeling complex flows — authentication and verification are highly branched, stateful, interruptible, and resumable, and need to be abstracted into testable, reusable models rather than nested conditionals

- Solid engineering practice: modular architecture, component design, unit and E2E testing, CI/CD, and responsible judgment on breaking changes to shared libraries (versioning, staged rollout, rollback)

- Proficient with AI-assisted development tools (Cursor / Claude Code / Copilot, etc.) with practical experience incorporating them into daily development workflows

- Fluency in Mandarin is required to be able to coordinate with overseas partners and stakeholders. Additional languages would be an advantage.

 Why Binance 

- Shape the future of finance 

- Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure

- Tackle challenging projects in a fast-paced and innovative enviornment with autonomy

- Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning

- Competitive salary and company benefits

- Remote-first, work-from-home arrangement (may vary depending on the nature of the role and team)

 Binance is committed to being an equal opportunity employer. We believe that having a diverse workforce is fundamental to our success.

 By submitting a job application, you acknowledge that you have read our Candidate Privacy Notice .

 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Location / work arrangement: San Francisco, San Mateo, Seattle & Vancouver (Canada)

About the Role

Xero’s ledger is the source of truth for millions of businesses, and every product we ship is built on top of it. We are rebuilding this integrity layer for the next 20 years, and we are standing up the Vancouver engineering hub around it from day one. As Lead Engineer, you will make the architectural decisions that set the course for the platform and the team, and you will see those decisions reach every customer who depends on Xero to get their numbers right.

 


THE TECHNICAL CHALLENGES

 - Correctness at scale. Accounting data has to be consistent, auditable, and immutable. There is no “close enough,” and every change to the ledger has to preserve that guarantee across regions and regulations.

 - Evolving a mature system. We are adding real-time expectations to a platform that millions of businesses depend on daily. That means strengthening service boundaries and clarifying data contracts without compromising reliability.

 - Durable, high-throughput services. We use durable execution (for example, Temporal) to keep long-running financial workflows accurate and recoverable under load.

 - AI-ready data. We are structuring accounting data so it can power AI-native experiences while maintaining trust in the numbers.

 


IMPACT

 - First six months: You understand the ledger and its consumers, align the team on service boundaries and data contracts, and ship a first modernization increment with no loss of data integrity.

 - First twelve months:
   
   - You have set the architecture for the core accounting capabilities (general ledger, journals, chart of accounts, multi-currency).
   
   - The Vancouver engineering team has clear ownership and quality standards, thanks in part to your leadership and role modeling.
   
   - Your work reaches customers through every product built on the ledger, and the decisions made now will shape Xero for years.

 


OWNERSHIP

You will own the technical direction for your area of the accounting platform, from design through production and on-call. You will make architectural decisions on service boundaries, data contracts, and technology choices without needing sign-off, and you will be accountable for reliability and data integrity end to end. You will also help set hiring, quality, and ownership practices for an early and growing team, which will compound over time.

 


WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

Bernardo Farah is the Director of Engineering for Accounting Core. He has over 10 years of SaaS software experience, including six years building platforms and growing teams at Samsara.




WHAT YOU BRING


MUST-HAVE:

 - You set the standard for your team in AI-assisted development, operational excellence, and flexible architecture.

 - A track record delivering highly available, distributed backend systems and designing high-throughput services under production constraints.

 - Depth in system architecture, API design, and both SQL and NoSQL databases

 - Proficiency in a modern backend stack such as C#, Java, Go, or C++, plus cloud-native platforms like AWS.

 - You demonstrate strong ability in breaking down complex problems into clear, actionable solutions while driving agile execution to deliver results.


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with financial, ledger, or accounting systems, or other domains where data integrity is critical

 - Experience with durable execution or workflow engines such as Temporal

 - Experience modernizing a mature system without disrupting customers

 


HOW WE WORK

Process is a tool for impact and we adjust accordingly. We use an agile approach to ship outcomes, not to follow ceremony. Code and design reviews are where we trade ideas and hold the quality bar, and we are figuring out how to use LLMs to reduce how much code humans have to write and review by hand. Our on-call rotation draws on a healthy pool of engineers and turns incidents into learning through postmortems. Decisions are made at every level, and we make sure everyone has the strategic context to raise proposals and drive innovation.

 
 

Our Hiring Process

 - Stage 1: Real World coding assessment, 45 Mins

 - Stage 2: Systems Design assessment, 45 Mins

 - Stage 3: Technical Deep dive, 60 Mins

 - Stage 4: Values/ Future Proof, 60 Mins

 - Stage 5: Leadership interview, 60 mins

 

Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team. We are also tech stack agnostic, so please apply if you've worked with adjacent technologies.



Compensation & Total Rewards

At Xero, we value the impact and skills you bring to the team. We don’t just hire for a role; we invest in people. We believe in a Total Package philosophy - which means your value isn't just a single number on a paycheck. While base salary is a core component, we look at your compensation through a holistic lens that includes equity, performance incentives, and world-class benefits.

The expected base salary range for this role in:

Individual pay is determined by various factors, including geography, level of experience, and the specific skills you bring to the role.

In addition to base pay, Xero’s roles are eligible for the following forms of variable compensation:

 - Variable Pay: Permanent employees are eligible to participate in our annual bonus and equity (RSU) programs. You may also be eligible for performance-based cash or equity (RSUs) incentives depending on your role level, and company performance.

 - Comprehensive Benefits: Medical, dental, vision, 401(k) match, and 21 days PTO, 10 days of Wellbeing leave, 5 days of Xtra Leave, 1 volunteer day, 12 paid holidays, paid parental leave. Further information included on our Xero Perks https://careers.xero.com/inside-xero/benefits-wellbeing/ page.
