jobs.title: Software Development Engineer, Data Center Builder Tools
jobs.jd:
The Data Center Builder Tools team is looking for a seasoned, self-directed Software Development Engineer (SDE II) to help define AWS next generation real-time middleware and controls platform that powers industrial control systems across AWS Data Centers worldwide. Contribute to Amazon's vision of developing the safest, most secure, reliable, and efficient data centers on Earth.

As a Software Development Engineer on this team, you will set the technical direction for the software that sits between industrial hardware and the cloud, a unified, real-time data plane that lets control applications, device drivers, and cloud services exchange data reliably on industrial computing hardware. This is deep systems work at the boundary of software and hardware: you will own the architecture of the controls, the communication layer, and the protocol and cloud integrations that the entire platform is built on, and you will be the engineer others turn to for the hardest problems in real-time, distributed, and embedded systems.

Key job responsibilities
As an SDE II on this team, you are a technical leader accountable for the architecture and long-term health of the controls and middleware platform, not just individual components. You will operate across multiple workstreams and teams, make the consequential design decisions, and remain deeply hands-on where it matters most.

Your primary responsibilities will include:

* Architecting the platform, not just components: owning the end-to-end design of the controls and real-time middleware across embedded/edge controllers and the cloud, making the durable decisions on type systems, serialization, memory layout, schema evolution, and communication patterns that everything else depends on.

* Owning real-time correctness at system scale: reasoning about latency budgets, throughput, determinism, and failure modes across a distributed system adjacent to physical control loops, and setting the standards that keep those guarantees intact as the system grows.

* Raising the engineering bar broadly: establishing standards for testing (unit, integration, and on-hardware validation), performance benchmarking, operational excellence, and code quality, and holding the team to them through design and code review.

* Growing engineers: mentoring Junior SDEs, developing their technical judgment, and contributing as a strong interviewer and bar raiser in hiring.

* De-risking the hardest problems: personally diving into the highest-ambiguity, highest-impact technical challenges (new protocol integrations, performance-critical paths, cross-language data exchange) and bringing them to a proven, maintainable end state.

The ideal candidate is a software engineer with a track record of owning the architecture of complex software systems and delivering them to production. You have depth across several of: real-time or embedded systems, industrial automation platforms and hardware protocols, distributed systems, middleware/messaging (pub/sub, RPC), and cloud communication and the breadth to reason about how all of these fit together into a coherent platform. You are comfortable working close to the metal (memory, concurrency, serialization, timing) and setting direction at the system and organizational level. You influence beyond your own team, make sound decisions under ambiguity and hardware/timing constraints, and lift the engineers around you. Experience with Rust, C/C++, or Python, and with technologies such as industrial automation platforms, OPC-UA, DDS/Zenoh or similar real-time middleware, is a strong advantage.

The role and its impact

As a Senior Engineer on the Enterprise Platforms team, you will provide technical expertise across the platforms, integrations, automations, and AI tools that support Xero’s global teams. You will help navigate complex technical challenges from planning through implementation, keeping systems secure, reliable, scalable, and easy to use.



Serving as a trusted technical guide, you will offer practical advice on system changes, incidents, and continuous improvement. Working alongside your Platform Lead, you will improve technical standards, reduce system clutter, and build reusable solutions that make daily work smoother for everyone.



The team and how they connect

The Enterprise Platforms team partners closely with Product Managers, Analysts, Security, Architecture, and Operations to deliver sensible internal solutions. They look after Xero's core SaaS platforms, cloud services, and custom integrations, collaborating through configuration sessions, pair problem-solving, and shared learning. Together, the team focuses on streamlining workflows and maintaining operational excellence across internal technologies.



Initially, you will focus on

 - Enhancing enterprise SaaS platforms, cloud services, and internal automation workflows using APIs and modern platform features.

 - Designing, developing, and supporting integrations, data migrations, and AI-enabled workflows to connect internal systems safely.

 - Investigating complex technical incidents, determining root causes, and applying lasting fixes to keep production systems stable.

 - Creating clear documentation, runbooks, policies, and reusable design patterns to support consistent platform management.



Where and how you can work

Xero offers a flexible hybrid working model designed to give you balance and connection. You will work from our modern office spaces, coming together with your team on designated boost days to collaborate, connect, and innovate, while enjoying the flexibility to work remotely for the remainder of the week.



Here are some of the things we are looking for

 - A strong background in building, configuring, and supporting cloud services or enterprise SaaS platforms.

 - Practical experience creating integrations, automations, or system workflows using APIs, scripting, and modern tools.

 - Demonstrated ability to diagnose technical incidents, resolve root causes, and maintain reliable production environments.

 - Talent for translating business and user needs into clear, secure, and practical technical solutions.

 - Expertise in applying security guidelines, access controls, and change management principles within live systems.

 - Skill in mentoring team members, sharing technical knowledge, and communicating complex technical concepts clearly to diverse stakeholders.



Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

jobs.jd:
Who we are

 About Stripe 

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

 About the team 

 Radar helps businesses prevent payments fraud and abuse while enabling legitimate customers to transact with confidence. We combine machine learning and AI with the intelligence of Stripe’s global network to make sophisticated fraud prevention accessible to businesses of all sizes.

 Our work spans payments fraud detection, protection against abuse beyond the payment, enterprise APIs that bring Radar’s capabilities into businesses’ own systems and payment flows, and the platform that powers it all. We build everything from reliable, low-latency infrastructure to intuitive tools that help users understand threats and control how they respond.

 Fraud evolves constantly, and so do we. We work directly with users to understand emerging attacks, turn advances in ML and AI into effective defenses, and build products that protect and grow their revenue.

What you’ll do

 As a software engineer on Radar, you’ll build products and infrastructure that help businesses understand and stop fraud and abuse. Your work will span backend services, enterprise APIs, and user experiences that put sophisticated prevention capabilities into our customers’ hands.

 You’ll own problems from investigation through launch, partnering with product managers, designers, and data scientists. You’ll have opportunities to scale systems that make real-time decisions across Stripe’s global payments network, bring advances in ML and AI into production, and build new products from scratch. Every improvement can have a direct impact on the revenue our users retain and the legitimate customers they serve.

 Responsibilities 

- Build and operate reliable, low-latency services that detect and prevent fraud and abuse at scale

- Design APIs and dashboard experiences that help businesses investigate threats, configure defenses, and understand how Radar protects them

- Develop the shared platform and infrastructure that enable teams to build and launch new Radar capabilities

- Work directly with users to understand emerging threats and turn those insights into broadly useful products

- Partner with ML engineers and data scientists to bring new signals, models, and AI capabilities into production

- Own projects end to end, from technical design and implementation through rollout, measurement, and iteration

- Uphold a high bar for engineering quality, reliability, and product craft while moving quickly as threats evolve

Who you are

 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

 Minimum requirements 

- 2+ years of industry software engineering experience

- Strong coding skills in any programming language, with experience building and maintaining production software

- Ability to work across systems and technologies, learn unfamiliar codebases, and make thoughtful technical trade-offs

- A rigorous approach to problem solving, including using data to investigate issues and evaluate whether a solution works

- Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work across disciplines and contribute to your peers’ success

- An ownership mindset and comfort navigating ambiguity, taking initiative, and following through on user problems

 Preferred qualifications 

- Experience building distributed systems or real-time services with demanding reliability and latency requirements

- Experience building APIs, developer platforms, or intuitive user interfaces for complex workflows

- Experience bringing ML or AI capabilities into production software

- Experience working on fraud prevention, abuse prevention, risk, or security

- Experience taking a product from an early idea to launch and iterating directly with customers

jobs.jd:
About Faire 

 Faire is a technology wholesale platform built on the belief that the future is local. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. At Faire, we're using the power of tech, data, and machine learning to connect this thriving community of entrepreneurs across the globe. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

 We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

 About the role: 

 Our Engineering organization owns the software that makes our marketplace work. Our Product Security team enables product engineering teams to develop and deploy secure software that makes that happen. We care about good engineering practice and love to write software that is secure, tested, easy to maintain, and can scale to millions of users. We build scalable, reusable frameworks; consult with product teams; listen to the data; and iterate.

 As a Senior Software Engineer, Product Security, you'll collaborate with us to: 

- Build performant and scalable frameworks for security use cases such as authentication and data access into our Kotlin services.

- Collaborate with foundational teams such as Risk, DevOps, and IT to assess and improve access controls and audit trails throughout the software development lifecycle and beyond.

- Consult with product teams to identify and address product security vulnerabilities and risks during the design and build phase.

- Promote a culture of security awareness and understanding among managers, engineers, and other stakeholders on secure coding practices, security best practices, and emerging threats.

- Build security features within the product to protect our customers and their data.

 We're excited about you because you have: 

- A passion for programming and solving security problems scalably with code and automation

- A familiarity in both writing and reviewing code in OOP languages such as Java, Python, or Typescript

- A bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Software Engineering or equivalent industry experience

- A thorough understanding of web application security principles and common vulnerabilities, including OWASP Top 10

- Experience working in modern cloud computing environments such as AWS or GCP

 Technologies we use and teach: 

- Kotlin, Typescript, Python

- AWS, OCI, Terraform, Kubernetes

- HTTP, JSON, and Protocol Buffers

- MySQL, DynamoDB, CockroachDB

 Salary range: 

 Canada: the pay range for this role is $ 160,000 - $ 222,000 per year. 

 This role will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Actual base pay will be determined based on permissible factors such as transferable skills, work experience, market demands, and primary work location. The base pay range provided is subject to change and may be modified in the future.
 Hybrid Faire employees currently go into the office 3 days per week on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and a third flex day of their choosing (Monday, Wednesday, or Friday). Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting. 

 Why you’ll love working at Faire 

- Flexible paid time off, plus company-wide recharge days

- Paid parental leave up to 16 weeks

- Comprehensive health coverage, with options varying by location

- Fertility and family-building benefits through Carrot, including a lifetime reimbursement allowance

- Mental health support and coaching through Modern Health

- Stipends to support your professional development, wellness, and work from home needs

- Employer-sponsored retirement plan, dependent on country of employment

 Faire was founded in 2017 by a team of early product and engineering leads from Square. We’re backed by some of the top investors in retail and tech including: Y Combinator, Lightspeed Venture Partners, Forerunner Ventures, Khosla Ventures, Sequoia Capital, Founders Fund, and DST Global. We have headquarters in San Francisco and Kitchener-Waterloo, and a global employee presence across offices in Toronto, London, and New York. To learn more about Faire and our customers, you can read more on our blog .

 Faire provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity or gender expression.

 Faire is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Accommodations are available throughout the recruitment process and applicants with a disability may request to be accommodated throughout the recruitment process. We will work with all applicants to accommodate their individual accessibility needs. To request reasonable accommodation, please fill out our Accommodation Request Form ( https://bit.ly/faire-form) 

 Privacy 

 For information about the type of personal data Faire collects from applicants, as well as your choices regarding the data collected about you, please visit Faire’s Privacy Notice (https://www.faire.com/privacy)

 About Salesforce 
 Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
 
 Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

 The Experience 

Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together customer support engineers, proactive monitoring, specialist product advisors and technical architects. This team not only resolves technical issues but also provides expert guidance on optimizing and demonstrating Salesforce technology to drive long term business success.

Success Architects, as part of Cloud Success, play a pivotal role in supporting Salesforce's most critical and strategic customers. They provide expert guidance on solution design, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment to standard methodologies. By assessing system performance, they help optimize efficiency and reliability while proactively identifying risks and recommending improvements to maintain technical health. Additionally, they offer strategic insights into application lifecycle management, enabling customers to plan, develop, and evolve their Salesforce implementations effectively. Through deep expertise, Success Architects empower businesses to improve their Salesforce investment, aligning technology with business goals for long-term success.

The Success Architect collaborates closely with various teams across Customer Success and the Product organization to drive long-term solutions for customers. They work with support engineers to resolve immediate technical challenges while identifying root causes to prevent future issues. Partnering with customer success managers, they ensure customers receive strategic guidance on standard methodologies and long-term technology health. By bridging the gap between customers, support, and product development, Success Architects help create sustainable solutions that enhance the overall Salesforce experience.

- Innovate & Solve Problems – Identify capability gaps and design inefficiencies, recommending product enhancements or creative custom solutions that drive customer success and long-term adoption. 

- Execute Proven Strategies – Leverage and tailor Success Architect playbooks to meet the unique challenges and opportunities of Financial Services Cloud customers. 

- Build Strong Relationships – Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement, and overall business growth.

- Proven years of experience in software, system, or enterprise architecture. 

- Expertise in Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance, and best practices. 

- Experience with large-scale, complex implementations, including SaaS, PaaS, multi-tenancy, and multi-tiered infrastructure.

- Familiarity with vertical-specific solutions among retail, manufacturing, education, non-profit (preferred).

- Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.

jobs.jd:
Why join us 

 Brex is the intelligent finance platform that enables companies to spend smarter and move faster in more than 200 markets. By combining global corporate cards and banking with intuitive spend management, bill pay, and travel software, Brex enables founders and finance teams to accelerate operations, gain real-time visibility, and control spend effortlessly. Brex’s AI-native automation and world-class service eliminate manual expense and accounting tasks for customers so they can focus on what matters most. Tens of thousands of the world's best companies run on Brex, including DoorDash, Coinbase, Robinhood, Zoom, Plaid, Reddit, and SeatGeek.

 Working at Brex allows you to push your limits, challenge the status quo, and collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the industry. We’re committed to building a diverse team and inclusive culture and believe your potential should only be limited by how big you can dream. We make this a reality by empowering you with the tools, resources, and support you need to grow your career.

 Engineering at Brex 

 Engineering at Brex is about building systems that scale with speed and intention. Our teams operate with high autonomy and deep collaboration, own outcomes end to end, and push for excellence from architecture to deployment. It’s an environment where engineering is a craft and builders grow by solving meaningful technical problems.

 What you’ll do 

 As a Senior GRC Engineer at Brex, you’ll lead the IT security compliance workstreams that connect our technical control owners to the people who examine our controls: external auditors, Internal Audit, state regulators, and Finance. You’ll coordinate and test the technical controls behind our financial reporting (SOX/ITGC), our annual SOC 1 Type 2 report, our state money transmitter examinations, and our FINRA IT requirements. You’ll also run the annual business continuity and disaster recovery (BC/DR) testing calendar.

 As part of the GRC team you may also contribute to the following operational tasks:

- Third party risk management 

- Risk register maintenance and reporting

- Customer Trust / GTM due diligence support

- Tooling access requests

- Assist with requests related to other certifications like SOC 2 Type 2, PCI DSS, or ISO 27001

 Where you’ll work 

 This role will be based in our Vancouver office. We are a hybrid environment that combines the energy and connections of being in the office with the benefits and flexibility of working from home. We currently require a minimum of three coordinated days in the office per week, Monday, Wednesday and Thursday. As a perk, we also have up to four weeks per year of fully remote work!

 Responsibilities 

- Lead IT SOX/ITGC test procedures, walkthroughs, evidence, workpapers, and remediation across logical access, change management, computer operations, and IT governance.

- Manage our annual SOC 1 Type 2 engagement, including external auditor coordination, control descriptions, evidence, deficiency tracking, and review of draft report sections.

- Support state money transmitter (MTL) examinations by working with Legal, Compliance, and Finance on IT documentation, examiner requests, and tracking of IT findings.

- Test quarterly user access reviews, privileged-access evidence, and segregation-of-duties remediation, and verify that in-scope changes are complete and properly authorized.

- Run the annual BC/DR testing calendar, including tabletop and failover exercises, and document results, evidence, and remediation.

- Prepare FINRA-related IT control documentation, including business continuity, books-and-records, systems access reviews, and readiness testing.

- Track findings through to closure with clear control owners, deadlines, and evidence, and keep audit coordination separate from control operation.

- Support broader GRC team operational tasks related to evidence collection, access requests, and risk management.

 Requirements 

- 5+ years of experience in IT audit, SOX/ITGC testing, GRC, or technology compliance, in fintech, financial services, or public accounting.

- Hands-on experience with ITGC testing across logical access, change management, and computer operations, and with documenting results in audit workpapers.

- Working knowledge of SOC 1 / SSAE 18, including Type 2 reports, control descriptions, and deficiency management.

- Familiarity with PCAOB standards.

- Experience working with external auditors, regulators, or examiners and responding to their requests on deadline.

- Strong organization and project management skills, with the ability to run several audit workstreams on different calendars at once.

- Clear communication, and comfort holding technical control owners accountable for evidence and remediation.

 Bonus points 

- CISA, CIA, CPA, or CISSP certification.

- Experience with state money transmitter examinations or FINRA IT and books-and-records requirements.

- Experience coordinating BC/DR testing, including tabletop and failover exercises.

Job Description: 
 Job Title: Senior Engineer 
 Location: Pune, India 
 Corporate Title: AVP 
 
 Role Description 
 As a Senior Engineer in the Channel Security team, you will be a core individual contributor responsible for the hands-on development of our mission-critical platform. You will focus on writing high-quality, scalable code for the backend services that power our real-time channel security capabilities. You will work closely with the Lead Engineer to build, test, and deploy a resilient and performant system
 
 Overview: 
 
- Corporate Banking is a technology centric business, with an increasing move to real-time processing, an increasing appetite from customers for integrated systems and access to supporting data. This means that technology is more important than ever for business.

- Deutsche Bank is one of the few banks with the scale and network to compete aggressively in this space, and the breadth of investment in this area is unmatched by our peers. Joining the team is a unique opportunity to help rebuild the core of some of our most mission critical processing systems from the ground-up.

- Our Corporate Bank Technology team is a global team across 30 countries. The primary businesses that we support within Corporate Bank are Cash Management, Securities Services, Trade Finance and Trust & Agency Services. CB Technology supports these businesses through ‘vertical’ CIO aligned teams and by ‘horizontals’ such as Client Connectivity, Surveillance and Regulatory, Infrastructure, Architecture, Production, and Risk & Control.
 
 What we’ll offer you 
 As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy
 
- Best in class leave policy

- Gender neutral parental leaves

- 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)

- Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education

- Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members

- Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents

- Accident and Term life Insurance

- Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above
 
 Your key responsibilities 
 
- Design, develop, test, and deploy high-quality, scalable backend microservices for the Channel Security platform using Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and related technologies.

- Partner with the Lead Engineer on solution design and participate actively in code reviews to ensure alignment with architectural principles and maintain high code quality standards.

- Implement robust integrations with internal and external systems.

- Champion a "shift-left" approach to quality by writing comprehensive unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for all new features.

- Contribute to the operational health of the platform by participating in troubleshooting, and incident resolution as part of our "you build it, you run it" culture.

- Collaborate with the DevOps engineer to ensure services are observable, easy to deploy, and meet non-functional requirements for performance and reliability.
 
 Your skills and experience 

- Strong, hands-on backend programming experience with the modern Java ecosystem (Java 17+, Spring Boot).

- Overall experience of 9-14 years in software engineering, with a strong focus on building robust, scalable banking systems.

- Hands-on Experience using AI coding assistants such as GitHub Copilot, or experimenting with LLMs/AI APIs to improve engineering productivity, testing, troubleshooting, or automation

- 

- Solid understanding of microservices architecture, RESTful APIs, and distributed systems principles.

- Practical experience with event-driven architecture and messaging systems, specifically Kafka.

- Experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL) and an understanding of in-memory data stores/caches (Redis).

- A strong commitment to quality with hands-on experience in writing various levels of automated tests (unit, integration, E2E, BDD).

- Experience working in a cloud-native environment (GCP preferred) and familiarity with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).

- Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD pipelines, and agile development methodologies.

- Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to debug complex issues across multiple services.

- A collaborative mindset with strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively within a lean, focused engineering team.
 
 Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs. 
 
 How we’ll support you 
 
- Training and development to help you excel in your career

- Coaching and support from experts in your team

- A culture of continuous learning to aid progression

- A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
 
 About us and our teams 
 Please visit our company website for further information:
 https://www.db.com/company/company.html 

 We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.
 Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.
 
 We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

The Role:
 We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer for the Internal Data Platform team, reporting to the team’s Senior Engineering Manager. This role suits candidates with experience building data platforms at scale and a passion for solving complex analytical problems with modern technologies.
 The successful candidate will have extensive experience in software development, distributed systems, cloud technologies and infrastructure, and ideally in data platforms. Data engineering skills are valuable, but this is primarily a software engineering role. 
 As part of our team, you will help develop and maintain solutions for Atlassian's data platform, focusing on reliability, scalability and performance. You will have the chance to build a petabyte-scale data lake using vendor, open-source and custom-built technologies. You will collaborate with a diverse team of backend engineers to serve stakeholders ranging from data engineers and data scientists to product managers and senior leadership.

- Design, develop and own the delivery of high-quality data platform and software services to support a petabyte-scale data lake.

- Drive improvements in operational excellence, including security, reliability, availability, performance, procedures and processes.

- Use a data-driven approach to inform decisions and design technical solutions.

- 5+ years of experience in a software engineering role, preferably in the data platform domain.

- A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related discipline.

- Expertise in solving complex distributed systems problems.

- Experience building applications in one or more of the following languages: Kotlin, Scala, Java or Python.

ABOUT FLOAT

Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth. 

 

As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/rob-magazine/top-growing-companies/article-ranking-canadas-top-growing-companies-of-2024/ and top-rated startups in 2025 https://www.linkedin.com/posts/floatfinancial_were-proud-to-share-that-float-has-been-activity-7387093684720300032-2DDz/, 2024 https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-top-startups-2024-15-canadian-companies-rise-linkedin-news-llihe/ and 2023 https://lnkd.in/TSU23CA, Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.

 

At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success.




OUR PRODUCT

Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 10,000 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C https://floatfinancial.com/press/float-financial-raises-cad-85-million-series-c, and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.

 

Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada.




AI USE IN OUR HIRING PROCESS

We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.

Float is building an agent that works as a chief financial officer for every Canadian business: it knows the business, has all the context, and works around the clock. You would join the small team building the foundation for it, with a blank slate and a direct line to the product teams that will build on what you make.



You’ll have the best seat in the house on how to apply the frontier to real finance problems: taking raw model intelligence and turning it into durable, scalable, useful products. The team sits between the model providers, Float’s product teams, and the customers whose finances we run, building the harness —memory, skills, tools, evals, observability, distribution channels — that every agent at Float runs on.



This is a zero-to-one position. You will build the core pieces that let agents act reliably in production, and the interfaces and channels customers reach them through, then scale them across Float’s products. The field is moving quickly, so the best people here learn fast and are glad to rebuild something when a better approach arrives.



We are hiring across multiple levels for this role. Our interview process evaluates scope, judgment and learning velocity, and we level accordingly. At Staff, you set the patterns the harness is built on and the evaluation and observability bar every agent at Float meets. This role suits engineers who have shipped agents to real users, want more ownership than a large company can offer, and like to build.




WHAT YOU'LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

 - Ship agents that save customers real money and time. Take them from the first prototype to production at scale, and own the outcome once they’re live.

 - Build the unified harness. Context management, capabilities and tool use, evaluation, monitoring and observability — the layer every agent at Float runs on and scales through.

 - Make agent actions safe to trust with a company’s money. Permissions, approvals, audit trails, and clear behaviour when the agent is uncertain or wrong.

 - Define what good looks like and measure it. Offline evals, production monitoring of agent decisions, and the loop that turns incidents into improvements.

 - Build the interfaces agents are delivered through. Chat, generative UI, and multiple channels at once.

 - Make product teams faster. Partner with them so they can launch their own agent capabilities on the harness without rebuilding it.

 - Stay on the frontier. Track models, inference and context management, and rework what we’ve built when a better approach appears.

   - Stand up the evaluation framework that tells us, before and after launch, whether an agent’s answers about a company’s spend are correct.

jobs.jd:
About Us

 At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

 At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

 Available Locations: Atlanta, GA; Austin, TX; Denver, CO; New York City; San Francisco, CA; Seattle, WA; Washington D.C.; Toronto, Canada

 About the role 

 Many of Cloudflare’s critical internal services run on Kubernetes. These services include those responsible for Cloudflare’s control plane and APIs, data analytics and other internal tools used to manage our global network. These Kubernetes platforms are purpose-built from the ground up and run on bare metal Linux in different regions around the world. The scale we work at involves tens of thousands of containers and terabits per second of network traffic. The team takes pride in knowing this platform helps run parts of the global Internet.

 As an engineer on the Kubernetes platform team, you'll be building the tools to help engineers deploy and operate the services that make Cloudflare work. Our mission is to provide a reliable and flexible platform to help product teams release new software efficiently and safely. The role includes both software engineering and DevOps operational responsibilities.

 Responsibilities 

- Design scalable and resilient systems that can keep up with company growth.

- Work with application teams to understand their needs and challenges, and help them choose the best way to architect their systems to run well in our Kubernetes environment.

- Harden the platform against security threats, noisy neighbours, and accidents.

- Improve the efficiency of our use of resources such as CPU, memory, bandwidth, and storage.

- Help respond to, resolve, and prevent incidents impacting the platform or our users.

- Contribute back to the open source community. Some of our favorite open source projects include: Envoy, Contour, Consul, etcd, cdk8s, Cloudprober, Calico, Ceph, Rook, KubeVirt, and more.

 Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience 

- Experience managing production Kubernetes clusters.

- Experience operating systems on-premise at scale in roles such as SRE, systems design or architecture.

- Excellent debugging skills in a Linux environment.

- Knowledge of how container runtimes work inside of Linux (isolation, storage, and networking).

- A firm grasp of IP networking including routing and iptables/nftables.

- Ability to work with codebases in Go, TypeScript, and Bash/shell.

- The ability to break down complex problems into smaller pieces, provide options, talk through trade-offs, build consensus, and drive the effort to solve the problem.

 Bonus Points 

- Familiarity with building platforms across multiple zones and regions as the foundation for other teams to build distributed highly-available applications.

- Experience with configuration management frameworks such as SaltStack or Ansible.

- Experience with continuous deployment tooling like ArgoCD and Argo Rollouts.

- Operational/administrator experience with etcd, Ceph, Rook, KubeVirt, CNIs, ClusterAPI, Envoy, and/or Contour.

- Experience as a user of Prometheus, Elasticsearch/Kibana, Vault, Redis, and/or Consul.

Compensation

 Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

- For San Francisco based hires: Estimated annual salary of $194,000 - $266,000

- For Denver based hires: Estimated annual salary of $168,000 - $231,000

- For New York City based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000

- For Seattle based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000

- For Washington D.C. based hires: Estimated annual salary of $185,000 - $254,000

- For Toronto, Canada based hires: Estimated annual salary of $150,000 - $206,000

Applications will be accepted until December 25, 2026.

Equity

 This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.

Benefits

 Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family. Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun! The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

 Health & Welfare Benefits

- Medical/Rx Insurance

- Dental Insurance

- Vision Insurance

- Flexible Spending Accounts

- Commuter Spending Accounts

- Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

- On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

- Global Travel Medical Insurance

 Financial Benefits

- Short and Long Term Disability Insurance

Powering this hub is a set of Rust-based services operating on every one of the data-centers that Cloudflare runs. These services route all of Cloudflare One traffic end to end. By leveraging Cloudflare's incredible infrastructure and programming languages such as Rust, this critical service is safe, performant and secure.
As Cloudflare Zero Trust set of features evolves, this team is responsible for evolving these hub services to deliver those new capabilities while guaranteeing scalability and reliability as top priority.

 As a software engineer on the Zero Trust Connectivity team, you will contribute across a wide range of technologies and systems to deliver new solutions that connect Cloudflare One products together. You will build connectivity in a user-space service that can identify and route flows across our global network. This work requires close collaboration with other teams while leveraging powerful frameworks and libraries that power many Cloudflare products. What Makes Cloudflare Special?

 We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet. 

 Project Galileo : Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost. 

 Athenian Project : In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states. 

 1.1.1.1 : We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. jobs.jd:
About Anthropic 

 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

 Platform Intelligence turns each new Claude model's abilities into API features that developers can build on. Our goal is to make the full intelligence of each model available through the API. We own the capabilities that shape what Claude can do for developers: tool use, built-in tools such as web search and code execution, thinking controls, structured outputs, and the memory, files, and skills APIs.

 We also run the API side of every Claude model launch, including its safety features and controls. That means getting the API ready for each new model, coordinating with research, safeguards, product, and cloud partners, and making sure the model, its features, the SDKs, and the docs all ship together on launch day.

 The work sits where research meets product. We work with new models before they are public. When a model gains a new ability, we work out what it should look like as an API, build it, and ship it to developers on our own platform and on cloud platforms. Those decisions shape how developers first use each model. We also own API versioning and the evals that tell us a capability works in production.

What you'll do

 You'll lead the design, build, and operation of API capabilities used by developers around the world. You'll work with research to understand what a new model can do and turn that into an interface that is simple, durable, and hard to misuse.

 You'll lead the API side of new model launches. You'll plan the work, track readiness across teams, resolve the issues that come up late, and see the launch through on the day. Between launches, you'll make the next one faster and safer.

 You'll set technical direction for work that spans several teams, write clear design proposals, review API designs from other teams, and mentor engineers on the team.

Representative projects

- Lead API readiness for a Claude model launch, so that every feature works on day one across our API, SDKs, docs, and cloud partners

- Take a new model ability from research prototype to public API feature, from interface design to production rollout

- Build and operate tools such as web search and code execution under real traffic

- Automate the manual parts of a model launch

- Build the evals that catch a capability regression before a launch

You might be a good fit if you:

- Have led technical projects that spanned several teams, from design through launch and operation

- Have designed and operated production distributed systems where correctness, latency, and availability all matter

- Have strong product sense and care about API design and developer experience

- Make sound technical decisions with incomplete information, as models and priorities change close to a launch

- Explain tradeoffs clearly to research, product, and go-to-market partners, including non-engineers

- Make the engineers around you better through design review and mentoring

- Use AI tools as a regular part of how you design, build, and review software

- Care about the societal impacts of your work and Anthropic's mission to build safe, beneficial AI

 Strong candidates may also have: 

- Building public APIs, SDKs, or developer platforms

- Working with large language models, including tool use, agents, or evals

- Running launches or migrations with fixed deadlines and many dependent teams

- Building tools for agents, such as search or code execution

- Storage, memory, or context systems at scale

- Integrating with cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure

 Deadline to apply: None. Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis. 

 Location Preference: Preference will be given to candidates based in NY, SEA, SF or the Bay Area given the current location of team. 
 The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

 For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

 Annual Salary:
 $405,000 — $485,000 USD 

 Logistics

 Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

 Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

 Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

 Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

Who we are

About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

About the team

 The Collaboration team helps Stripe employees work smarter and more efficiently, get to know each other, and request and receive help from one another. The team is nimble and creative. We work across a wide stack; on any given day, we discuss user interface design, data models, API design, infrastructure maintenance, agentic integrations, or all of the above. We’re excited to innovate in a space that traditionally isn’t thought of as in the forefront of innovation.

 Being a small team, we carefully choose what we work on to have the highest leverage. This is not always easy—we work very cross-functionally, partnering with groups from engineering to Communications to senior leadership. But one of our greatest rewards is getting to sit next to and see the impact our work has on our users: our fellow Stripe employees.

What you’ll do

 As an engineer on Stripe’s Collaboration team, you will be a key member of a team that acts as a force multiplier on the internal tools that Stripe uses. You will focus on building innovative AI-native experiences that help Stripe employees be more productive across various tasks and activities. You’ll collaborate with other teams across Stripe, combine traditional hands-on engineering with emerging AI capabilities, and experiment with different ideas and approaches to empower and delight your users.

Responsibilities

- Work with a team of smart, motivated engineers who put their users first.

- Own solutions from end to end, managing complexity and engaging directly with stakeholders to think through everything from success metrics to MCP tooling to the nitty-gritty implementation details of the products you build.

- Leverage the latest AI tooling to refine and optimize both your users’ workflows and your own.

- Use both qualitative and quantitative metrics to determine priorities and measure effectiveness.

- Uphold Stripe’s high standards for engineering and product quality and mentor newer team members to do the same.

 Who you are 

 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 

Minimum requirements

- You have 6+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years of industry experience building rich web experiences using modern frameworks such as React, Vue, etc.

- You work well across a full stack, from user experience to workflow automations to reliability. 

- You enjoy working directly with users and cross-functional partners to build creative solutions that address their problems.

- You are able to think rigorously, navigate ambiguity, and make hard decisions and tradeoffs.

- You enjoy working together with your team toward common goals, but are also able to drive your work forward autonomously

 Preferred qualifications 

- You have a passion for enabling people to do their best work.

- You have an interest in partnering with creative, non-technical teams, such as those responsible for Stripe’s creative communications and publishing efforts.

- You have a track record of shipping LLM-powered experiences with a strong understanding of how underlying technologies work.

- You have industry experience working with Ruby, TypeScript, and React.

OpenAI’s Hardware organization develops AI-native silicon and system-level solutions for the unique demands of advanced AI workloads. Building on efforts like Jalapeño, our custom silicon program, the team works across silicon architecture, RTL design, verification, physical design, systems software, and infrastructure to deliver highly performant, efficient, and scalable hardware solutions.

The Silicon & Systems team brings together hardware and software engineers to co-design and build the next generation of AI infrastructure. We operate at the intersection of silicon, systems, and software, tackling complex technical challenges across the full hardware development lifecycle, from early architecture and design through validation, deployment, and production.

About the Role

We’re looking for an Infrastructure Software Engineer to build and scale the infrastructure and developer workflows that power OpenAI’s custom silicon development. You’ll work closely with engineering teams across design verification, physical design, emulation, formal verification, and systems software to develop reliable, automated, and efficient workflows that accelerate hardware development.

In this role, you'll own and improve the cloud infrastructure, high-performance computing (HPC) environments, CI/CD pipelines, regression systems, and data platforms that support our silicon engineering teams. You'll translate complex hardware development requirements into scalable infrastructure solutions, reducing manual overhead, improving reliability, and enabling engineers to iterate faster.

This is a highly collaborative, hands-on role with opportunities to drive improvements across the entire hardware development lifecycle.  - Build data infrastructure and observability: Develop data pipelines, databases, and monitoring systems that provide visibility into regression results, infrastructure health, resource utilization, and engineering efficiency.

 - Drive platform reliability and operational excellence: Troubleshoot complex infrastructure issues, improve monitoring and alerting, automate recovery processes, and build systems that are resilient, maintainable, and scalable.

This senior engineering position plays a central role in transforming how software reliability and observability are delivered across our entire product landscape. You will help set technical direction and build standardised, intelligent observability systems that enable product teams to embrace automated, agentic-first development practices.



Beyond driving technical execution, you will help design robust data pipelines and telemetry frameworks while supporting colleagues across the organisation. Your efforts directly influence how systems operate reliably under load, standardising performance monitoring and accelerating how engineering teams build and release software.



The team / how they connect



You will join our central Observability team within the platform organisation, working alongside engineers dedicated to reliability, platform performance, and data architecture. Operating with high autonomy, the team collaborates remotely across Australia and New Zealand to establish shared reliability benchmarks and support product squads across the business. Communication is transparent, open, and built around collective problem-solving and technical experimentation.



Initially, you will focus on



 - Building standardised data pipelines and telemetry layer architectures to enable intelligent, agentic development workflows.
   
   

 - Implementing open telemetry standards and vendor-agnostic instrumentation across distributed applications.
   
   

 - Driving platform efficiency, cost optimisation, and monitoring performance metrics across cloud systems.
   
   

 - Designing automated alerting and reliability scorecards to streamline incident investigation and system health tracking.
   
   

Where and how you can work



This position offers flexible remote working arrangements for candidates based across Eastern time zones in Australia. Whether you choose to work entirely from home or access our modern office spaces in Sydney, Melbourne, our flexible setup supports your preferred rhythm alongside regular opportunities for team connection.



Here are some of the things we are looking for



 - Experience managing distributed tracing, metrics, and log aggregation within large-scale cloud environments.
   
   

 - Practical familiarity with OpenTelemetry standards and vendor-agnostic instrumentation techniques.
   
   

 - Deep understanding of distributed systems architecture and diagnosing platform behavior under high load.
   
   

 - A strong interest in artificial intelligence tooling, intelligent operational workflows, and data model automation.
   
   

 - Demonstrated ability to collaborate across engineering teams, share knowledge, and lift platform standards.
   
   

 - A proactive approach to problem-solving, taking ownership of complex reliability challenges from design to execution.
   
   

Apply even if your experience isn't a perfect match! At Xero, we hire based on your skills, passion, and the unique perspective you can bring to enhance our culture and team.

 This is a hands-on engineering role focused on building benchmarks and investigating performance, with technical publishing as a shared responsibility alongside engineering and content partners.

- Adapt and extend workload-appropriate tools such as Elasticsearch Rally, ClickBench, and vector search benchmark frameworks.

- Investigate performance differences using profiling, system metrics, and controlled experiments; collaborate with engineering teams to identify causes and validate improvements.

- Evaluate relevant self-managed and managed cloud deployments, including serverless offerings, accounting for scaling behavior and service constraints.

- Partner with engineering and product management to prioritize benchmark coverage and translate findings into actionable product improvements.

- Solid software engineering skills, with experience building maintainable automation and analysis tools in Python or another relevant programming language.

- Hands-on experience evaluating and diagnosing performance in distributed systems, databases, or search infrastructure.

- Depth in at least one relevant area (search, vector retrieval, analytical databases, or observability systems) and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems.

- Experience building reproducible test environments and documenting configurations, procedures, and results.

- Clear technical writing and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex findings and their limitations.

- Solid collaboration skills and the ability to turn performance evidence into applicable engineering recommendations.

- Experience measuring retrieval quality alongside latency, throughput, and resource usage.

- Familiarity with cloud performance and cost analysis, including autoscaling and serverless systems.

- Public technical writing, open-source contributions, or published benchmark studies.

jobs.jd:
Who we are

About Stripe

 Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career. 

About the team

 Supportability Decisions is a Dublin-based engineering team within Supportability Engineering, part of Risk Engineering. We own the “how a business sells” side of Supportability: determining whether a user’s declared business, web presence, account configuration, and observed transaction behaviour align with Stripe’s standards.

 Our core domain includes transaction-laundering detection and decisioning, web-presence and URL-policy controls, and low-quality e-commerce detection. We consume the signals and evaluations that support decisions in these spaces and convert them into evidence-based and auditable determinations that can be shared with the rest of the Supportability platforms.

 The pitch is: join a high-ownership team solving some of Stripe’s hardest risk problems. We build technology that helps Stripe distinguish legitimate businesses from bad actors at scale, combining sophisticated engineering, AI-assisted investigation, and meaningful real-world impact.

What you’ll do

 You will own a meaningful part of a risk-decisioning problem from investigation and design through implementation, rollout, measurement, and iteration. You will help build both the domain capabilities and the modern agentic infrastructure required to make Supportability decisions consistent, stateful, explainable, and appropriate to the business, product, and moment in time. Depending on team priorities and the candidate’s experience, this may include:

Responsibilities

- Building the Supportability Decision Layer: a durable service and API through which automated systems, agents, and human reviewers can request, produce, retrieve, and understand canonical decisions.

- Developing the infrastructure that enables agentic investigations to synthesize policy, business identity and history, product context, risk appetite, and multiple assessment signals into explainable, confidence-calibrated decisions.

- Improving the transaction-laundering agent’s policy grounding, evidence quality, risk tiering, precision and recall, and use of behavioural, dispute, and other relevant signals.

- Designing durable decision state and history, including traceability from supporting evidence through reasoning and applied consequence, and validity and refresh policies that prevent stale outcomes from persisting.

- Building governed, reusable configuration and integration patterns that adapt decision capabilities across products, partners, countries, and permitted risk appetites without creating bespoke systems for each use case.

- Building reliable backend workflows on shared Supportability and Risk Platform infrastructure.

- Making complex risk decisions explainable to reviewers and affected users.

- Using data and feedback from outcomes, appeals, and corrections to improve decision quality while balancing the identification of bad actors against avoiding unnecessary harm to legitimate businesses.

- Modernising URL enforcement, including when and how URL checks run, reducing unnecessary review volume and user friction, and supporting migration away from legacy systems.

- Expanding shared SAE/SPO decisioning foundations, including due-diligence support and product-scoped remediation and appeal capabilities.

- Improving the Process Orchestration Framework and moving workflow code into more maintainable platform packages.

- Contributing to future work in automated LPM URL screening, low-quality e-commerce detection, wider web intelligence, and active test charges.

 Who you are 

 We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement. 

Minimum requirements

- 2 - 7 years of industry software engineering experience (does not include internships or co-ops)

- You work effectively across the stack from top to bottom, comfortably navigating codebases with different languages and tools

- You're equally comfortable shipping user-facing experiences as you are writing custom queries to analyze experiment results

- Strong coding skills in any programming language (we understand new languages can be learned on the job, so our interview process is language-agnostic)

- Strong collaboration skills, with the ability to work across workstreams within your team and contribute to your peers' success

- Ability to thrive on a high level of autonomy and responsibility, and think of yourself as entrepreneurial

- Interest in working as a generalist across varying technologies and stacks to solve problems and delight both internal and external users

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working in high-growth teams similar to Stripe

- Experience building financial systems or tools for financial experts

Role Description 

 As a Senior Client Platform Engineer on CorpFleet Engineering, you will lead the migration to FleetDM and build the shared platform capabilities that support dependable endpoint operations. You will combine hands-on engineering with technical planning, partnering with Windows, macOS, and Linux engineers to introduce changes safely across a distributed environment.
You will develop automation, integrations, and configuration-as-code workflows, validate platform capabilities, and guide phased adoption. Beyond migration, you will improve platform reliability, visibility, and maintainability, helping the team reduce manual work and operate the service with shared ownership.
You will partner with Security, IAM, CorpInfra, and support teams to resolve dependencies and make practical trade-offs. This is an individual-contributor position with technical leadership and mentoring responsibilities.

 Responsibilities 

- Lead the FleetDM migration. Define scope, requirements, architecture, dependencies, and a phased delivery plan with OS specialists and partner teams. 

- Engineer and operate the shared platform. Maintain configuration, agent workflows, policies, queries, integrations, and operational automation. 

- Make deployment safe and repeatable. Build version-controlled configuration with automated checks, peer review, controlled rollout, drift detection, and recovery. 

- Validate capabilities and coexistence. Identify gaps, clarify management authority, and establish which responsibilities should migrate or remain with existing tools. 

- Make platform health actionable. Establish trustworthy device populations, data freshness, enrollment and agent health, and owned remediation workflows. 

- Protect service continuity. Use representative pilots, acceptance gates, employee-impact checks, and clear pause and recovery decisions. 

- Strengthen team capability. Create reusable patterns, documentation, and shared support coverage through pairing, mentoring, and operational handoffs. 

- Improve efficiency and cost. Reduce recurring manual work and recommend tooling consolidation where evidence supports it. 

 Requirements 

- Significant hands-on experience engineering enterprise endpoint platforms, including deep expertise in at least one of Windows, macOS, or Linux and experience working across OS boundaries. 

- Personal ownership of a multi-phase platform migration or comparable change, including discovery, pilots, rollout, recovery, and operational handover. 

- Strong practical programming or scripting skills, such as Python, Go, PowerShell, or shell, with production automation and API integration experience. 

- Demonstrated use of Git, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for configuration or infrastructure changes. 

- Ability to diagnose enrollment, agent, policy, identity, networking, and integration failures and distinguish missing data from healthy devices. 

- Experience establishing monitoring, failure handling, least-privilege access, secrets management, and maintainable operational workflows. 

- Ability to independently define priorities, align cross-functional stakeholders, communicate trade-offs, and mentor engineers. 

- Clear written and verbal communication and effective asynchronous collaboration across regions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Production experience with FleetDM configuration, policies, queries, APIs, agent operations, or deployment automation. 

- Practical osquery and SQL experience, including query validation, performance considerations, targeting, and stale or missing results. 

- Migration or coexistence experience involving Intune, Jamf, or comparable endpoint-management platforms. 

- Experience integrating endpoint platforms with identity, security, inventory, or ITSM services. 

- Experience supporting developer-heavy, distributed environments. 

- Demonstrated improvements in platform operating effort, tool consolidation, or lifecycle cost. 

 Durable Skills 

 AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. We believe people with these skills will thrive as work and technology continue to evolve: 

- Awareness: U nderstand yourself and others . 

- Judgment: E valuat e information and mak e decisions in complex situations . 

- Adaptability: L earn, adjust, and stay effective through change . 

- Connection: C ommunicat e , collaborat e , and build trust . 

 To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser.

Unlike the hands-on DevOps Engineer (who operates day-to-day pipelines within a single track), the DevOps Architect operates at the Hub level — defining branching strategy, environment topology, pipeline standards, test automation frameworks, deployment governance and cross-wave dependency management that apply consistently to every track team.

This role is accountable for ensuring the Hub never becomes a bottleneck — that release pipelines are fast, reliable, auditable and capable of supporting multiple concurrent go-lives within the same programme window.

The DevOps Architect is also responsible for the platform development tooling contribution model — governing how Apex, LWC, Flow and integration code built by track teams is developed, reviewed, tested and promoted through Hub environments to production.

 What You'll Actually Be Doing 

- CI/CD Pipeline Architecture — Hub Standard: Design, build and own the Hub-wide CI/CD pipeline framework using Salesforce DX, GitHub Actions and Gearset/Copado — defining the standard pipeline stages (develop → validate → test → UAT → staging → production) that apply to every migration track, wave and release. 

- Environment Topology Design: Design and manage the Hub environment topology — defining the number, purpose and refresh cadence of Developer, CI, SIT, UAT, Staging and Production environments across all active migration waves, balancing environment costs with delivery velocity requirements. 

- Branching Strategy & Version Control Governance: Define and enforce the Hub-wide Git branching strategy — including branch naming conventions, merge policies, pull request standards, conflict resolution protocols and release tagging — ensuring all Salesforce DX source code, metadata and configuration is correctly version-controlled. 

- Scratch Org Strategy: Design the Hub’s Salesforce DX scratch org usage model — defining scratch org definitions, feature flags, shape parameters and lifecycle policies that enable track teams to develop and test in isolated, reproducible environments at scale. 

- Deployment Governance & Release Management: Own the release management process for all migration wave deployments — defining change freeze windows, deployment sequencing, dependency maps, rollback procedures, approval gates and production deployment runbooks used across all concurrent waves. 

- Test Automation Framework: Design and implement the Hub-wide automated test suite — including Apex test class standards, code coverage requirements, UI automation (LWC Jest, Selenium), data validation scripts and post-deployment smoke tests — integrated into every CI/CD pipeline stage.

- Secrets & Credential Management: Design and enforce secure secrets management for all Hub environments — including connected app credentials, API keys, org authentication certificates, ETL connection credentials and third-party integration tokens using vault-based or CI/CD-native secrets management. 

- Monitoring & Observability: Design the Hub’s deployment monitoring and observability framework — including pipeline run dashboards, deployment success/failure metrics, apex test trend monitoring, environment health checks and post-deployment alert routing for track teams and programme leadership. 

- DevOps Engineer Mentoring & Standards: Act as the technical lead and mentor for DevOps Engineers embedded in each migration track — setting development standards, reviewing pipeline configurations, conducting DevOps design reviews and ensuring consistent tooling adoption across all track teams.
